title.en: World Desk
title.zh: 全球焦点

strap.en: A fast view of global affairs, conflict, diplomacy, and human need.
strap.zh: 快速掌握国际局势、冲突、外交与人类处境。

title.en: Germany’s Merz cancels phone call with Trump after social media post celebrating AfD win – Europe live
title.zh: 泽连斯基称俄军袭击乌克兰回应“太少”，在最新致命袭击后呼吁盟友采取更多行动

summary.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that the international response to recent deadly Russian attacks on Ukraine has been insufficient. He made this call for greater action from allies following overnight strikes that resulted in two fatalities. Meanwhile, in Germany, Alice Weidel of the AfD party...
summary.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基表示，国际社会对近期俄罗斯致命袭击乌克兰的回应“太少”。在造成两人死亡的夜间袭击之后，他呼吁盟友采取更多行动。与此同时，在德国，选择党（AfD）的爱丽丝·维德尔在联邦议院表示，周末萨克森-安哈尔特州的选举结果表明“人民终于想要政策改变”，并称现任执政联盟应被“推翻”。

body.en: Spokesperson for Merz declines to give a reason for cancellation, but notes that it was not due to scheduling German chancellor accuses far-right AfD party of seeking ‘ethnic cleansing’ Back to Oslo, the funeral procession for King Harald is about the begin, and the 1.2km route to the Oslo Cathedral is lined up with 1,900 soldiers from all branches of the Norwegian defence forces. The procession is expected to walk very slowly – at around 60 steps per minute – and will include the royal family, including King Haakon , followed by a royal car with the widow, Queen Sonja. Continue reading...
body.zh: 德国选择党的艾丽丝·韦德尔在联邦议院表示，周末的萨克森-安哈尔特州选举结果表明“人民最终希望改变政策”，并称执政联盟应该“结束”。她还严厉批评政府在移民、针对俄罗斯的“战争宣传”以及能源方面的记录，呼吁恢复通过北溪管道的输送。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of continued deadly strikes in Ukraine, met with a call for more international action, underscores the tragic cycle of conflict. President Zelenskyy's plea echoes the deep human yearning for an end to violence. The challenge remains to find pathways that overcome escalating hostility, not by mirroring it, but by seeking just and lasting peace.
reflection.zh: 乌克兰持续遭受致命袭击的消息，以及要求国际社会采取更多行动的呼吁，凸显了冲突的悲剧性循环。泽连斯基总统的恳求呼应了人类对结束暴力的深切渴望。挑战依然在于寻找能够克服不断升级敌意的方式，不是以暴制暴，而是寻求公正持久的和平。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Trump center stage at RNC in midterms gamble – US politics live
title.zh: 特朗普在共和党全国代表大会上成为焦点，为中期选举冒险

summary.en: President Trump is set to deliver speeches on both days of an unprecedented gathering, which Republicans are framing as a 'midterm convention' to counteract his unpopularity. Meanwhile, Stefany Shaheen, daughter of a New Hampshire senator, has won the Democratic nomination for a House seat, facing accusations of...
summary.zh: 总统特朗普将在前所未有的集会的两天内都发表讲话，共和党人将其定位为“中期选举大会”，以对抗他的不受欢迎度。与此同时，新罕布什尔州参议员的女儿斯蒂芬妮·沙欣赢得了众议院席位的民主党提名，但面临初选对手关于裙带关系的指控。

body.en: President to give speeches on both days of unprecedented gathering Republicans look to ‘midterm convention’ to overcome Trump unpopularity Sign up for US Breaking News email Stefany Shaheen, the daughter of a longtime New Hampshire senator and former governor, has won the Democratic nomination in the race for Chris Pappas’s former House seat. Stefany Shaheen’s mother Jeanne Shaheen is a former governor who has represented New Hampshire in the Senate since 2009. The younger Shaheen’s family ties to the Democratic establishment – and accusations of nepotism – became a point of attack by her opponent in the primary race. Continue reading...
body.zh: 总统将在这两天史无前例的聚会上发表演讲，共和党人希望通过“中期大会”来克服特朗普不受欢迎的情况。新罕布什尔州长期参议员和前州长的女儿史蒂芬妮·沙欣(Stefany Shaheen)在克里斯·帕帕斯(Chris Pappas)前众议院席位的竞选中赢得了民主党提名。斯蒂芬妮·沙欣 (Stefany Shaheen) 的母亲珍妮·沙欣 (Jeanne Shaheen) 是前州长，自 2009 年以来一直代表新罕布什尔州参议院。小沙欣的家庭与民主党建制派的关系 — — 以及裙带关系的指控 — — 成为她的对手在初选中攻击的一个焦点。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The political landscape often brings scrutiny to family ties and perceived advantages, as seen with Stefany Shaheen's nomination. The call to 'act justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God' reminds us to evaluate actions and motivations with integrity, seeking fairness and ethical conduct above all else, even amidst political maneuvering.
reflection.zh: 政治格局常常使家族关系和所谓的优势受到审视，正如斯蒂芬妮·沙欣的提名所示。‘行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心与你的雅伟同行’的呼召提醒我们，即使在政治操纵之中，也要以正直来评估行为和动机，将公平和道德行为置于一切之上。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: John Malkovich cancels Israel trip over fabricated solidarity quote
title.zh: 约翰·马尔科维奇因捏造的团结引语取消以色列之行

summary.en: Actor John Malkovich has canceled a planned trip to Israel to perform in 'The Music Critic' in Tel Aviv. The cancellation stems from a public relations firm's decision to attribute fabricated quotes to the actor, a move Malkovich deemed 'unacceptable and untenable'.
summary.zh: 演员约翰·马尔科维奇取消了原定于明年在特拉维夫演出音乐剧《批评家》的以色列之行。此次取消源于一家公关公司为演员捏造了引语，马尔科维奇认为此举“不可接受且无法维持”。

body.en: The Wild Horse Nine actor had been due to appear on stage in The Music Critic in Tel Aviv – but pulled out over PR firm’s ‘unacceptable and untenable’ attribution of statement John Malkovich has cancelled a planned trip to Israel next year to appear on stage after a PR firm hired by the show attributed quotes to the actor that the company had written. Malkovich, who is a leading Oscar contender for his role in Martin McDonagh’s Wild Horse Nine , was due to appear in The Music Critic, a theatrical-musical satire composed by the Jewish violinist Aleksey Igudesman, in Tel Aviv’s Charles Bronfman Auditorium on 13 April. Continue reading...
body.zh: 这位《野马九人》的演员原定要在特拉维夫的《音乐评论家》的舞台上亮相，但因公关公司“不可接受且站不住脚”的声明而退出。约翰·马尔科维奇取消了明年前往以色列登台的计划，此前该剧聘请的一家公关公司将公司所写的引述归咎于该演员。马尔科维奇因在马丁·麦克唐纳的《野马九人》中扮演的角色而成为奥斯卡主要竞争者，他将于 4 月 13 日在特拉维夫查尔斯·布朗夫曼礼堂出演由犹太小提琴家阿列克西·伊古德斯曼创作的戏剧音乐讽刺剧《音乐评论家》。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of John Malkovich canceling his Israel trip due to fabricated quotes serves as a stark reminder of the power and responsibility that comes with communication. In a world saturated with information, the integrity of our words, whether spoken or written, is paramount. Ephesians 4:25 calls us to "put off falsehood and speak truthfully each one to his...
reflection.zh: 约翰·马尔科维奇因捏造的引语取消以色列之行的消息，鲜明地提醒我们沟通所带来的力量和责任。在一个充斥着信息的时代，我们言语的诚信——无论是口头还是书面——都至关重要。以弗所书4:25呼吁我们“弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说诚实话”。这一原则不仅在公共关系中至关重要，在我们所有的互动中也同样重要，有助于建立信任和真诚的联系。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Ethiopia's constitutional reform: What does it mean — especially for Abiy?
title.zh: 埃塞俄比亚宪法改革：这对阿比意味着什么？

summary.en: Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed could benefit from planned constitutional reforms that would reshape the country's political power, potentially granting him a stronger mandate.
summary.zh: 埃塞俄比亚总理阿比·艾哈迈德可能从计划中的宪法改革中受益，这些改革将重塑该国的政治权力格局，并可能赋予他更强大的执政授权。

body.en:
Does Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed stand to benefit from a planned constitutional reform in the country? A new presidential system would reshape political power — and could give him even more power in office.

Since 2018, Abiy Ahmed has been the most powerful man in Ethiopian politics, governing the country during some of its most trying days in recent history. From the Tigray war to a feeble but lasting peace with neighboring Eritrea , Abiy has actively shaped and reshaped Ethiopia's role in Africa and indeed the world.

Soon, he might even get to consolidate more power and influence in his office, as Ethiopia 's political system might fundamentally change in the future.

Following weeks-long consultations, there are indications that the offices of prime minister and president could potentially be merged. This would mean that the largely ceremonial presidency could thus become the center of political power in the country.

While details about the precise re-designing of the system remain unclear, local reports say that the consultations indeed resulted in a positive recommendation to create a stronger presidency.

During a drawn-out national dialogue with around 4,000 delegates in Addis Ababa in recent weeks, participants discussed some of the country's key political conflict, including: the overall structure of the state, ongoing ethnic tensions, the rule of law and human rights — as well as the role of the prime minister.

Abiy did not take part in these meetings but could benefit significantly from their endorsement of a presidential system.

One key element for any constitutional reform to be pushed through parliament is already in place: Abiy won June's parliamentary elections   with a massive majority, which could help him and his party with advocating for a presidency with broader executive powers.  

Supporters of a stronger presidency see it as a way of bringing Ethiopia's ethnically and regionally fragmented society closer together.

A president representing the country as a whole could help strengthen a national political identity.

Befeqadu Hailu, an Ethiopian civil rights activist and political commentator, told DW that this might be a strength of the proposed new system, and that a president directly elected by the public would have a stronger mandate to govern.

Hailu believes that in future elections, a presidential candidate would have to convince "more than one ethnic group and more than one religious group" to win an election, which could help strengthen democratic processes.

At the same time, he issued a warning that "[p]residential systems are more prone descending into dictatorship."

body.zh: 埃塞俄比亚总理阿比·艾哈迈德是否会从该国计划中的宪法改革中受益？新的总统制将重塑政治权力，并可能赋予他更多的执政权力。 自 2018 年以来，阿比·艾哈迈德一直是埃塞俄比亚政坛最有权势的人，在近代历史上最艰难的一些日子里统治着这个国家。从提格雷战争到与邻国厄立特里亚的微弱但持久的和平，阿比积极塑造和重塑了埃塞俄比亚在非洲乃至世界的角色。 很快，他甚至可能会在自己的办公室中巩固更多的权力和影响力，因为埃塞俄比亚的政治制度未来可能会发生根本性的变化。 经过长达数周的磋商，有迹象表明总理和总统的办公室可能会合并。这意味着，主要是仪式性的总统职位可能因此成为该国政治权力的中心。 虽然有关系统重新设计的具体细节仍不清楚，但当地报道称，磋商确实产生了建立更强有力的总统职位的积极建议。 最近几周，在亚的斯亚贝巴与约 4,000 名代表举行了一场旷日持久的全国对话，与会者讨论了该国的一些关键政治冲突，包括：国家的整体结构、持续的种族紧张局势、法治和人权，以及总理的角色。 阿比没有参加这些会议，但可以从他们对总统制的认可中受益匪浅。 议会推动的任何宪法改革的一个关键要素已经到位：阿比以绝对多数赢得了 6 月的议会选举，这可能有助于他和他的政党倡导拥有更广泛行政权力的总统职位。 支持更强有力的总统职位的支持者认为，这是使埃塞俄比亚种族和地区分裂的社会更加团结的一种方式。 代表整个国家的总统可以帮助加强国家政治认同。 埃塞俄比亚民权活动人士、政治评论员贝菲卡杜·海鲁(Befeqadu Hailu)告诉德国之声，这可能是拟议新制度的优势，由公众直接选举产生的总统将拥有更强的执政权力。 海鲁认为，在未来的选举中，总统候选人必须说服“多个民族和多个宗教团体”才能赢得选举，这可能有助于加强民主进程。 与此同时，他发出警告称“住宅系统更容易陷入独裁。” 但关键...

reflection.en: As Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed considers constitutional reforms that could reshape political power, the question of righteous rule arises. Proverbs 16:12 reminds leaders that integrity and justice are the foundation of a stable throne, urging a focus on ethical governance over the mere accumulation of power.
reflection.zh: 随着埃塞俄比亚总理阿比·艾哈迈德考虑可能重塑政治权力的宪法改革，一个关于公义统治的问题浮现出来。《箴言》16:12 提醒领导者，正直和公义是稳固宝座的基础，敦促他们关注合乎道德的治理，而非仅仅是权力的积累。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: Tens of thousands line the streets as Norway bids farewell to King Harald V
title.zh: 挪威告别国王哈拉尔五世，数万人沿街送别

summary.en: Norway observed a minute's silence and held a series of ceremonies to bid farewell to King Harald V, concluding 13 days of national mourning. Tens of thousands lined the streets of Oslo for the funeral of the popular monarch, who reigned for over three decades and passed away at age 89.
summary.zh: 挪威为已故国王哈拉尔五世举行了一系列告别仪式，并默哀一分钟，为长达13天的全国哀悼画上句号。数万民众在奥斯陆街头送别了这位深受爱戴、统治超过三十年的君主，他于上个月以89岁高龄去世。

body.en: Europe’s royals and global political figures attend ceremony that brings 13 days of national mourning to a close Europe live – latest updates Norway has observed a minute’s silence as it takes leave of King Harald V in a series of ceremonies, bringing to a close 13 days of ​national mourning that followed the popular monarch’s death last month at the age of 89. Tens of thousands of people lined the streets of Oslo and foreign heads of state and government converged on the Norwegian capital for the funeral of the late king, a light-touch and unassuming reformer who ruled for more than three decades. Continue reading...
body.zh: 欧洲王室成员和全球政治人物出席仪式，为为期 13 天的全国哀悼活动画上句号 欧洲直播 - 最新消息 挪威在一系列仪式中默哀一分钟，告别国王哈拉尔五世，结束了上个月这位广受欢迎的君主去世（享年 89 岁）后为期 13 天的全国哀悼活动。已故国王的葬礼，这位统治了三十多年的温和而谦逊的改革家。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The passing of King Harald V marks the end of an era for Norway, bringing a close to 13 days of national mourning. The large public turnout and the presence of international dignitaries underscore the significance of his reign and the collective moment of transition the nation is experiencing. As the ceremonies conclude, there is a sense of both sorrow for...
reflection.zh: 哈拉尔五世国王的离世标志着挪威一个时代的结束，也为长达13天的全国哀悼画上了句点。公众的大规模参与以及国际政要的出席，都凸显了他统治时期的重要性，以及国家正在经历的集体转型时刻。随着仪式的结束，人们既为失去而悲伤，也转向未来，认识到生命的每一个阶段和每一次领导的更迭，都有告别之时，也有新的开始。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

title.en: Uganda pulling out of Prince Harry's Invictus Games, says military chief
title.zh: 乌干达宣布退出哈里王子发起的“不可征服运动会”，军方首脑称是为避免与英王对立

summary.en: Uganda is withdrawing from the Invictus Games, an event for wounded military veterans founded by Prince Harry, just two months after confirming its participation. The decision was announced by the chief of defence, who cited a desire to avoid any perception of opposition to King Charles III.
summary.zh: 乌干达宣布退出由哈里王子创立的、为受伤军人设立的“不可征服运动会”，而就在两个月前，该国还确认将参赛。此决定由国防军总司令宣布，他表示此举是为了避免被视为与英王查尔斯三世对立。

body.en:
Uganda is pulling out of the Invictus Games, a sports event for wounded military veterans run by the Duke of Sussex, only two months after the country said it would join.

General Muhoozi Kainerugaba, chief of defence and son of the president, made the announcement in a social media post on X.

He said the decision to withdraw from the games was "in order not to be construed as being opposed to His Majesty King Charles III".

Ugandan government spokesman Alan Kasujja confirmed this to the BBC: "General Kainerugaba decides whether or not the UPDF [Uganda People's Defence Force] participates in the Invictus Games. What you saw is his stated position. If it changes, he will let the world know."

The Ugandan military chief's announcement follows a letter sent this week on behalf of the King which made clear that Prince Harry and Meghan, who have now returned to the UK, were not working royals.

A report in The Times newspaper quoted the general's concerns about the "Harry-Meghan nonsense", suggesting this was the background to the decision.

"In order not to be construed as being opposed to His Majesty King Charles III of the United Kingdom, whom we deeply revere, Uganda hereby withdraws from the Invictus Games," said the general in an overnight post.

"We shall not participate in anything that does not have His Majesty's approval."

However, royal sources have said that the King encourages all projects which support wounded service personnel.

A spokesman for the Invictus Games said they had not received any official information about a potential withdrawal and have been seeking clarification from their contacts in Uganda.

Among other posts on X from General Kainerugaba on Thursday was one that read: "I consider myself the most handsome, most daring and glorious Commander who ever lived."

There was also a series of angry messages about other generals who had danced without his permission.

The participation of Uganda in the next games, to be held next year in Birmingham, was announced in July, when Prince Harry was in London promoting the sports event, which celebrates the resilience and rehabilitation of wounded military men and women.

body.zh: 乌干达宣布退出“不败运动会”，这是一项由苏塞克斯公爵举办的为受伤退伍军人举办的体育赛事，距离该国表示将参加仅两个月。 总统之子、国防部长穆胡兹·凯内鲁加巴 (Muhoozi Kainerugaba) 将军在 X 的社交媒体帖子中宣布了这一消息。 他表示，退出奥运会的决定是“为了不被视为反对查理三世国王陛下”。 乌干达政府发言人艾伦·卡苏贾向英国广播公司证实了这一点：“凯内鲁加巴将军决定乌干达人民国防军是否参加“不败运动会”。你看到的是他所声明的立场。如果有变化，他会让全世界知道。” 乌干达军事首长宣布这一消息之前，本周代表国王发出了一封信，信中明确表示，现已返回英国的哈里王子和梅根不是在职王室成员。 《泰晤士报》的一篇报道援引了将军对“哈里-梅根胡言乱语”的担忧，暗示这就是该决定的背景。 这位将军在连夜发的帖子中表示：“为了不被视为反对我们深深尊敬的英国国王查理三世陛下，乌干达特此退出“不败运动会”。” “未经陛下批准，我们不会参与任何事情。” 然而，王室消息人士称，国王鼓励所有支持受伤军人的项目。 Invictus Games 的发言人表示，他们尚未收到任何有关可能退出的官方信息，并一直在寻求乌干达联系人的澄清。 凯内鲁加巴将军周四在 X 上发布的其他帖子中写道：“我认为自己是有史以来最英俊、最勇敢、最光荣的指挥官。” 还有一系列关于未经他允许跳舞的其他将军的愤怒信息。 乌干达参加明年在伯明翰举行的下一场比赛是在七月宣布的，当时哈里王子正在伦敦宣传这项体育赛事，该赛事旨在庆祝受伤军人的恢复能力和康复。 在此注册，每周通过我们的皇家腕表时事通讯获取最新的皇家故事和分析。英国以外的人可以在这里注册。

reflection.en: The chief of defence's decision to withdraw Uganda from the Invictus Games, citing a desire to avoid perceived opposition to King Charles III, points to the complexities of international relations and the careful navigation required to maintain diplomatic harmony. Even in sports, the pursuit of peace and avoiding unnecessary conflict is a worthy...
reflection.zh: 乌干达国防军总司令决定退出“不可征服运动会”，理由是避免被视为与英王查尔斯三世对立，这凸显了国际关系的复杂性以及维持外交和谐所需的审慎考量。即使在体育领域，追求和平、避免不必要的冲突也是值得考虑的。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Syria arms depot explosion kills at least 14
title.zh: 叙利亚军火库爆炸致至少14人死亡

summary.en: An explosion at a temporary site near Sarmada in Syria's Idlib province, used to store weapons and war remnants, killed at least 14 people and wounded 11. Syrian authorities stated the materials were being temporarily stored before relocation.
summary.zh: 叙利亚西北部伊德利卜省萨尔马达附近一个临时储存武器和战争遗留物的地点发生爆炸，造成至少14人死亡，11人受伤。叙利亚当局表示，这些物资在被转移前正被临时存放在该地点。

body.zh: 爆炸发生在叙利亚西北部伊德利卜省萨尔马达市附近。国防部表示，武器和战争遗留物在搬迁之前暂时存放在该地点。 叙利亚当局报告称，周三，用于存放武器和该国长期内战遗留物的临时地点发生爆炸，造成至少 14 人死亡、另有 11 人受伤。 爆炸发生在伊德利卜省西北部萨尔马达市附近。 叙利亚国防部表示，武器和战争遗留物在运往其他地方之前暂时存放在该地点。据称，受伤者中有部分人员。 爆炸发生在充满挥发性物质的地区，导致二次爆炸和火灾，阻碍了应急响应。周三，爆炸现场一段时间冒出滚滚浓烟。 伊德利卜卫生部门表示：“萨尔马达市附近一个用于收集武器和战争遗留物的临时仓库发生爆炸，初步统计死亡人数为 14 人，受伤人数为 11 人。” 这是本月伊德利卜省发生的第二起此类致命事件。 9月1日，一辆运载弹药的车辆在宾尼什发生爆炸，造成五人死亡、多人受伤。 叙利亚最近才摆脱了十多年的内战，当时忠于新总统艾哈迈德·萨拉的军队推翻了巴沙尔·阿萨德并控制了大马士革。伊德利卜是该国战争期间受灾最严重的地区之一。 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: The news from Idlib province is a stark reminder of the lingering dangers from Syria's protracted conflict. Even in temporary storage, the remnants of war continue to claim lives, underscoring the deep human cost of violence. May Yahweh bring an end to these conflicts and disarm the instruments of destruction.
reflection.zh: 伊德利卜省传来的消息令人痛心地提醒我们叙利亚旷日持久冲突的遗留危险。即使是临时储存的战争遗留物，也继续夺走生命，这凸显了暴力的深重代价。愿雅伟结束这些冲突，并解除毁灭的工具。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: Germany's Merz attacks AfD in stormy debate after far-right election win
title.zh: 德国默茨在极右翼选举获胜后的激烈辩论中抨击选择党

summary.en: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz clashed with AfD leader Alice Weidel in parliament, calling her party a 'destructive force' with a migration policy that amounts to 'ethnic cleansing' for skilled workers. This occurred after the anti-immigration AfD party's significant victory in the state of Saxony-Anhalt.
summary.zh: 德国总理弗里德里希·默茨在议会中与选择党领导人爱丽丝·维德尔发生冲突，称该党是“破坏性力量”，其移民政策相当于对技术工人的“种族清洗”。此前，反移民的选择党在萨克森-安哈尔特州取得了显著的胜利。

body.en:
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has clashed with AfD leader Alice Weidel in parliament, calling her party a "destructive force" with a migration policy that amounts to "ethnic cleansing" for skilled workers.

Merz was addressing the Bundestag in the aftermath of the anti-immigration party's sweeping victory in the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt where it won almost 44% of the vote, while the chancellor's conservatives saw their vote halved.

Weidel told MPs that voters had shown that Merz's coalition with the centre left was a total failure and his time was up.

Merz hit back saying the AfD had harmed German interests by backing Russia, and its "remigration" policy would affect millions.

It is not yet clear whether the party will be able to form a government or not in Saxony-Anhalt, having fallen three seats short of an outright majority. No far-right party has won power in any of Germany's 16 states since World War Two, and Merz has admitted the "seismic" result has changed Germany.

The AfD's success has been praised by US President Donald Trump, who said "the Populist Party in Germany just had a really big night", linking the victory to "absolutely horrible immigration rules and regulations".

The AfD in Saxony-Anhalt has been labelled as "right-wing extremist" by German domestic intelligence and the party has promised a "deportation and remigration" offensive targeting irregular migrants.

Trump had been due to speak by phone to the German chancellor on Wednesday to mark the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks in the US, but the government spokesman in Berlin said the call had been postponed without saying why. No new date has been set.

Repeatedly heckled by AfD MPs, the chancellor told Weidel that one in six skilled workers had a migration background, and if her party had its way then its policy would amount to "nothing other than an ethnic cleansing in the skilled trades based on skin colour and origin".

While the government understood some deportations were needed, he said it made a careful distinction between those who contributed to German prosperity and those without permanent residency.

Disruption by AfD MPs became so loud that at one point Bundestag President Julia Klöckner threatened to start expelling people from the chamber: "We are not on a football pitch."

Weidel said mass migration had left Germans with daily knife violence and attacks on trains and in stations, but Merz warned that the AfD's plans would mean that no single care home, hospital or restaurant could function.

As leader of the main opposition party in the Bundestag, Weidel opened the session by telling Merz his Christian Democrats had been "pulverised" in Saxony-Anhalt, after winning 17.2% of the vote, and she accused his government with the Social Democrats of...
body.zh: 德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨在议会中与选择党领导人爱丽丝·韦德尔发生冲突，称该党是一支“破坏性力量”，其移民政策相当于对技术工人的“种族清洗”。 默茨在联邦议院发表讲话时，反移民党在东部萨克森-安哈尔特州取得了压倒性胜利，该党赢得了近 44% 的选票，而总理的保守派则得票数减少了一半。 韦德尔告诉国会议员，选民已经表明梅尔茨与中左翼的联盟彻底失败，他的时间到了。 默茨回击称，选择党支持俄罗斯损害了德国利益，其“移民”政策将影响数百万人。 目前尚不清楚该党是否能够在萨克森-安哈尔特州组建政府，因为该党距离绝对多数席位还差三个席位。自第二次世界大战以来，没有极右翼政党在德国 16 个州中的任何一个州赢得权力，默茨承认“震撼人心”的结果已经改变了德国。 德国选择党的成功得到了美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的赞扬，他表示“德国民粹党刚刚度过了一个非常重要的夜晚”，并将胜利与“绝对可怕的移民规则和法规”联系起来。 萨克森-安哈特州的德国选择党被德国国内情报部门标记为“右翼极端分子”，该党承诺针对非正规移民发起“驱逐和重新移民”攻势。 特朗普原定于周三与德国总理通电话，纪念美国 9/11 袭击事件 25 周年，但柏林政府发言人表示，通话已被推迟，但没有说明原因。尚未确定新的日期。 在多次受到德国选择党议员质问的情况下，财政大臣告诉韦德尔，六分之一的技术工人有移民背景，如果她的政党如愿以偿，那么其政策将无异于“基于肤色和血统对技术行业进行种族清洗”。 虽然政府明白需要进行一些驱逐，但他表示，政府对那些为德国繁荣做出贡献的人和没有永久居留权的人进行了仔细区分。 德国选择党议员的干扰声音如此之大，以至于联邦议院主席朱莉娅·克洛克纳一度威胁要开始将议员驱逐出议院：“我们不是在足球场上。” 韦德尔表示，大规模移民导致德国人每天都会遭受持刀暴力以及对火车和车站的袭击，但默茨警告说，德国选择党的计划将意味着没有一家疗养院、医院或餐馆能够运作。 作为联邦议院主要反对党的领导人，韦德尔在会议开始时告诉梅尔茨，在赢得 17.2% 的选票后，他的基督教民主党在萨克森-安哈尔特州被“粉碎”，她指责他的社会民主党政府……

reflection.en: In the heat of political debate, leaders can accuse each other of grave offenses, framing their opponents as fundamentally destructive. Yet, the Apostle Paul reminds us that our struggles are not merely against human adversaries. The deeper battles often involve unseen forces that fuel division and animosity, urging us to discern the spiritual dimension...
reflection.zh: 在激烈的政治辩论中，领导人可能会指责对方犯下严重罪行，将对手描绘成根本性的破坏者。然而，使徒保罗提醒我们，我们的挣扎不仅仅是针对属血气的仇敌。更深层的争战往往涉及加剧分裂和敌意的看不见的力量，促使我们辨别世俗冲突背后的属灵层面。

verse.textEn: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
verse.textZh: 因我们并不是与属血气的争战，乃是与那些执政的、掌权的、管辖这幽暗世界的，以及天空属灵气的恶魔争战。

title.en: Cambodia's floating schools hit by rising fuel costs
title.zh: 柬埔寨的浮动学校因燃料成本上涨而受阻

summary.en: The war in Iran has driven up fuel prices in Cambodia, impacting families who depend on fishing and boats for their livelihoods. For children living on Tonle Sap, these rising costs present an additional obstacle to their education.
summary.zh: 伊朗战争导致柬埔寨燃料价格上涨，挤压了依赖捕鱼和船只为生计的家庭。对于居住在洞里萨湖上的儿童来说，燃料成本的上涨为他们接受教育带来了又一道障碍。

body.zh: 伊朗战争导致柬埔寨燃油价格上涨，给依赖渔业和船只谋生的家庭带来了压力。对于生活在洞里萨湖的儿童来说，不断上涨的燃料成本构成了教育的另一个障碍。 每天早上，12 岁的 Soksan Set 都会面临着大多数同龄孩子从未想过的旅程。他家外面没有路，只有水。 Soksan 住在 Prek Toal，这是东南亚最大的淡水湖——洞里萨湖上的一个漂浮社区，船只是这里的主要交通工具。他是当地小学四年级的学生，他要漂流几公里去上课，有时还会沿途帮助年幼的孩子。 但渐渐地，Soksan 和他的教室之间最大的障碍不再是距离。它是燃料。他的家人和公社的许多其他人一样，靠捕鱼为生。当燃油价格上涨时，他们被迫做出艰难的选择。 “当汽油价格上涨时，我们没有足够的钱定期送孩子上学，”Soksan 的父亲、41 岁的 Set Soeum 说。 “我们捕获的鱼不够，每天需要大约三升（0.8 加仑）汽油才能长途捕鱼。正因为如此，Soksan 经常缺课。” 对于靠水为生的家庭来说，不断上涨的燃料成本很快就会成为他们接受教育的障碍。 柬埔寨严重依赖进口燃料，导致家庭面临全球价格冲击和区域供应中断的风险。 2026 年伊朗战争推高了能源成本，导致偏远社区的交通费用更加昂贵。在洞里萨湖周围，这对学生及其家人造成了影响。 根据世界银行的数据，3月份汽油价格上涨45%，柴油价格上涨超过70%，这是自2008年以来的最大单月涨幅。 根据全球汽油价格，目前汽油价格为每升 5,700 瑞尔（1.41 美元，1.21 欧元），比一年前的 4,500 瑞尔上涨 26.7%。 尽管柬埔寨的大部分燃料进口并不直接依赖霍尔木兹海峡，但它面临着全球油价上涨和影响区域供应商的供应中断的风险。柬埔寨的所有石油产品均依赖进口，国内没有炼油能力。 对于Soksan一家人来说，渔船和学校船上都感受到了压力。有时，他们借钱购买汽油。在其他日子里，他们会减少食物、衣服或学习用品的用量。 “五名学生筹集资金购买汽油，有时一次只买一升，”索克桑说。当他们连这个都负担不起时，他们就自己划船。 “我们自己划船。最多可能需要一个小时，但我们仍然尽力去学校，”他指出。 在洞里萨湖，12 岁的 Siyien Ly 步行 30 多分钟去学校……

reflection.en: The escalating cost of fuel, a ripple effect from distant conflicts, makes the daily journey to school a significant challenge for children like Soksan in Cambodia. This situation underscores the vulnerability of communities and the urgent need to advocate for those whose access to basic necessities, like education, is threatened.
reflection.zh: 燃料成本的不断上涨，是遥远冲突的连锁反应，使得像柬埔寨的索克桑这样的孩子，每天上学的路途都充满了挑战。这种情况凸显了社区的脆弱性，以及为那些基本需求（如教育）受到威胁的人们发声的紧迫性。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: White House pulls Tetris-style 'Build The Wall' game after copyright concern
title.zh: 白宫因版权担忧下架“建造围墙”游戏

summary.en: The White House has removed a Tetris-style game called 'Build The Wall' from its website after The Tetris Company raised concerns about copyright infringement. The game, which involved stacking blocks to build a wall, was part of a collection of arcade games on the White House site.
summary.zh: 白宫已从其网站上撤下一款名为“建造围墙”的俄罗斯方块风格游戏，此前俄罗斯方块公司就版权侵权问题表示担忧。该游戏涉及堆叠方块建造围墙，是白宫网站上的一系列街机游戏之一。

body.en:
The White House has taken down a Tetris-style game on its website called "Build The Wall", days after The Tetris Company raised concerns over its use of the game's likeness.

The game, which saw players stack blocks to build a wall to "protect the border" is one of five arcade games which have appeared on the White House website.

On 4 September the official Tetris account on X posted , external the firm was "not involved in the creation" of the game and it took "copyright infringement very seriously".

The White House has not responded to requests for comment from the BBC or given an official reason for the takedown.

"At Tetris we believe in the power of connection and building people together, not dividing them," the firm said in its initial response to the game.

"To our fans everywhere: we love you, we see you, and we're grateful to have you in our community."

The Tetris Company has had previous success in suing firms for infringing on its copyright - settling for an undisclosed fee with the makers of the iPhone game Mino in 2012, which it claimed stole the look and feel of the block-builder.

Four other arcade games still remain on the mini-game section of the White House website.

"Flappy Bill", a clone of the 2013 viral hit Flappy Bird sees players fly a bald eagle and dodging monuments from the National Mall.

Meanwhile in Rio Run, players must "patrol the line along the river", with gameplay reminiscent of the classic phone game Snake.

When players run into the edge of the map, a "Deported" number shows how many people the player was able to catch.

The games have drawn criticism from politicians, with Connecticut Democratic state senator Matt Lesser tweeting , external : "Heating oil is near an all-time high but hey you can play Border Tsar Tom Homan in a video game".

The arcade section is just one example of how the Trump administration has increasingly incorporated video game culture into its political messaging on social media.

In October 2025, the official White House X account drew criticism for posting an AI-generated picture of President Trump , external in a suit from the video game Halo.

Meanwhile on 6 March it posted a video which mixed footage of US military strikes in Iran with film and TV clips, as well a clip from Halo's protagonist Master Chief saying "finishing this fight".

The post was condemned by the Master Chief voice actor Steve Downes in a now-deleted tweet which called for "the producers of this disgusting and juvenile war porn" to remove his voice from the video.

The Pokémon Company International also criticised the White House's use of its imagery in March, when it included a tiny version of the popular character Pikachu in a meme posted online with the phrase "Make America Great Again".

Sign up for our...
body.zh: 白宫在其网站上下架了一款名为“Build The Wall”的俄罗斯方块风格游戏，几天前俄罗斯方块公司对其使用该游戏的相似性表示担忧。 这款游戏要求玩家堆叠积木来建造一堵墙以“保护边境”，这是白宫网站上出现的五款街机游戏之一。 9 月 4 日，X 上的俄罗斯方块官方账户对外发布消息称，该公司“没有参与游戏的创作”，并且“非常严肃地对待侵犯版权”。 白宫尚未回应 BBC 的置评请求，也没有给出删除的官方理由。 该公司在对该游戏的最初回应中表示：“在俄罗斯方块，我们相信联系的力量，并将人们团结在一起，而不是分裂他们。” “致我们世界各地的粉丝：我们爱你们，我们看到你们，我们很感激你们来到我们的社区。” 俄罗斯方块公司此前曾成功起诉侵犯其版权的公司，并于 2012 年与 iPhone 游戏 Mino 的制造商达成和解，并支付了一笔未公开的费用，该公司声称这款游戏窃取了积木游戏的外观和感觉。 其他四款街机游戏仍然保留在白宫网站的迷你游戏部分。 《Flappy Bill》是 2013 年热门游戏《Flappy Bird》的翻版，游戏中玩家驾驶一只秃鹰，躲避国家广场上的纪念碑。 与此同时，在《Rio Run》中，玩家必须“沿河巡逻”，其玩法让人想起经典手机游戏《贪吃蛇》。 当玩家跑到地图边缘时，“驱逐”数字会显示玩家能够抓住多少人。 这些游戏引起了政界人士的批评，康涅狄格州民主党州参议员马特·莱瑟(Matt Lesser)在推特上对外表示：“取暖油接近历史最高水平，但嘿，你可以在电子游戏中扮演边境沙皇汤姆·霍曼(Tom Homan)”。 街机部分只是特朗普政府如何越来越多地将视频游戏文化纳入其社交媒体政治信息的一个例子。 2025 年 10 月，White House X 官方账户因发布人工智能生成的特朗普总统照片而受到批评，照片中穿着电子游戏《光环》中的套装。 与此同时，3月6日，它发布了一段视频，将美国对伊朗的军事打击镜头与电影和电视剪辑混合在一起，以及《光环》主角士官长说“结束这场战斗”的剪辑。 士官长配音演员史蒂夫·唐斯（Steve Downes）在一条现已删除的推文中谴责了这篇帖子，呼吁“这部恶心的青少年战争色情片的制作者”从视频中删除他的声音。 神奇宝贝国际公司还批评了白宫在三月份使用其图像的行为，当时该公司在网上发布的一条表情包中加入了流行角色皮卡丘的小版本，并附有“让美国再次伟大”的短语。 报名参加我们的...

reflection.en: The White House game, 'Build The Wall,' was quickly taken down after copyright concerns arose, highlighting how even ambitious projects can falter when they overstep boundaries. This echoes the ancient story of Babel, where human ambition to reach the heavens led to confusion and division, reminding us that true progress is built on integrity and respect...
reflection.zh: 白宫的“建造围墙”游戏因版权担忧而迅速下架，这表明即使是雄心勃勃的项目，在越界时也可能受挫。这呼应了古代巴别塔的故事，当时人类 करण्याचा天に届こうとする野心は混乱と分裂をもたらし、真の進歩は壮大な計画だけでなく、誠実さと確立された秩序への敬意の上に築かれることを思い出させてくれます。...

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: N Korea has built two-storey uranium enrichment facility, says watchdog
title.zh: 朝鲜建造了两层铀浓缩设施，监督机构称

summary.en: The International Atomic Energy Agency has expressed serious concern over North Korea's construction of a new two-storey uranium enrichment facility at the Yongbyon nuclear complex, which is reportedly capable of housing up to 28 centrifuge cascades. The agency also noted an expanded annex at another enrichment site,...
summary.zh: 国际原子能机构对朝鲜在宁边核综合体建造新的两层铀浓缩设施表示严重关切，该设施据称可容纳多达 28 个离心机串。该机构还注意到另一个浓缩场地的扩建附属设施，这表明朝鲜的核基础设施正在稳步扩张。

body.en:
North Korea has built a new two-storey uranium enrichment facility, the head of the world's nuclear watchdog said this week, calling it a cause for "serious concern".

The new building is part of the main Yongbyon nuclear complex, and reportedly capable of housing up to 28 centrifuge cascades used to enrich uranium.

In a report published late last month, the International Atomic Energy Agency said Pyongyang has also begun operating an expanded annex at another enrichment site.

These findings point to a steady expansion of the North's sancitoned nuclear infrastructure. The agency, which has no inspectors in North Korea since it was expelled in 2009, relies on satellite imagery for assessments.

"The continuation and further development of the DPRK's nuclear programme are clear violations of relevant UN Security Council resolutions and are deeply regrettable," IAEA director Rafael Grossi said in a statement earlier this week.

The IAEA first referred to the existence of the building in June, although Grossi had mentioned the possibility earlier in the year.

In June, the agency said that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un visited a "newly inaugurated nuclear materials production factory" on 3 June, which it identified as the Yongbyon enrichment facility.

Kim had praised the country's "greatly expanded production capacity", adding that this would "offer the possibility of carrying out larger plans", according to the agency's report.

Despite running one the poorest countries in the world, Kim spends millions each year developing a secretive nuclear arsenal. A 2022 report by a non-proliferation think-tank put this figure at $640m.

"What makes North Korea's nuclear programme so concerning is that many of its facilities are unknown, concealed, and thus difficult to target," Edward Howell, a lecturer at the University of Oxford told the BBC.

"Beyond Yongbyon, we know that other facilities exist: Kangson, for instance. The embeddedness of North Korea's nuclear doctrine within its foreign and domestic policy means that we should expect there to be more concealed production sites."

The agency also said there were indications that operations had started at another enrichment facility in Kangson, near the capital Pyongyang, in January this year. An annex had first been constructed in Kangson in 2024, it said.

It had said in April that North Korea appeared to be stepping up its ability to make nuclear bombs, saying they were monitoring the apparent expansion of Yongbyon.

The North's nuclear programme has accelerated under Kim, who has overseen a record number of missile tests. The country has fired has numerous intercontinental ballistic missiles (ICBMs) since it began testing its long-range system in 2017.

The country has conducted six nuclear weapons...
body.zh: 世界核监管机构负责人本周表示，朝鲜建造了一座新的两层铀浓缩设施，称其引起“严重关切”。 新建筑是宁边主要核设施的一部分，据报道能够容纳多达 28 个用于浓缩铀的离心机级联。 国际原子能机构在上个月末发布的一份报告中表示，平壤还开始在另一个浓缩设施中运营一个扩建的附属设施。 这些发现表明朝鲜批准的核基础设施正在稳步扩张。该机构自 2009 年被驱逐以来，在朝鲜就没有检查员，依靠卫星图像进行评估。 国际原子能机构主任拉斐尔·格罗西在本周早些时候的一份声明中表示：“朝鲜核计划的继续和进一步发展明显违反了联合国安理会相关决议，令人深感遗憾。” 国际原子能机构于 6 月首次提及该建筑的存在，尽管格罗西在今年早些时候曾提到过这种可能性。 6月，该机构表示，朝鲜领导人金正恩于6月3日参观了“新落成的核材料生产工厂”，该机构将其确定为宁边浓缩设施。 据该机构的报告称，金正恩称赞该国“大大扩大了生产能力”，并补充说这将“提供实施更大计划的可能性”。 尽管金正恩统治着世界上最贫穷的国家之一，但他每年仍花费数百万美元开发秘密核武库。防扩散智库 2022 年的一份报告称这一数字为 6.4 亿美元。 牛津大学讲师爱德华·豪威尔（Edward Howell）告诉英国广播公司（BBC）：“朝鲜核计划之所以如此令人担忧，是因为它的许多设施都是未知的、隐蔽的，因此很难瞄准。” “除了宁边，我们知道还存在其他设施：例如降村。朝鲜的核理论融入其外交和国内政策意味着我们应该预计会有更多隐蔽的生产基地。” 该机构还表示，有迹象表明，位于首都平壤附近康村的另一个浓缩设施已于今年 1 月开始运营。据称，2024 年，康村首次建造了附楼。 它曾在四月份表示，朝鲜似乎正在加强制造核弹的能力，并称他们正在监视宁边的明显扩张。 在金正恩的领导下，朝鲜的核计划加速推进，他监督了创纪录数量的导弹试验。自 2017 年开始测试远程系统以来，该国已发射了多枚洲际弹道导弹 (ICBM)。 该国已经进行了六次核武器...

reflection.en: The news of North Korea's new uranium enrichment facility is a stark reminder of the persistent global challenge of nuclear proliferation. Isaiah's vision of nations beating their swords into plowshares offers a counterpoint to this cycle of armament, calling for a future where destructive power is transformed into tools for life and sustenance. May wisdom...
reflection.zh: 朝鲜新建铀浓缩设施的消息，令人警醒地提醒我们全球核扩散的严峻挑战。以赛亚先知关于列国将刀打成犁头的异象，与这种军备竞赛的循环形成鲜明对比，呼唤着一个将毁灭性力量转化为生命和滋养工具的未来。愿智慧引导列国走向和平与裁军的道路。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Syria: How the 'house of sisters' threat split society
title.zh: 叙利亚：“姐妹之家”的传言如何分裂社会

summary.en: Rumors about a 'house of sisters,' where kidnapped women from other Syrian sects are allegedly forced to convert to Islam, are fueling communal tensions. Layla, an Alawite math teacher and mother of three living in Damascus, decided to leave the country with her family due to fear, as her sect is often targeted due to...
summary.zh: 关于“姐妹之家”的传言——据说在那里，来自其他叙利亚教派的被绑架妇女被迫改信伊斯兰教——正在加剧社群间的紧张关系。居住在大马士革的阿拉维派数学教师、三个孩子的母亲莱拉（Layla）因恐惧而决定举家离开该国，因为她的教派常因与叙利亚前独裁者巴沙尔·阿萨德有关联而成为目标。

body.en:
Rumor has it that the 'house of sisters' is where kidnapped women from other Syrian sects are forced to convert to Islam. Nobody knows if it really exists, but it's being used to create communal tensions anyway.

A knock on the door, a muted threat and then they made the decision to leave the country, says Layla, a math teacher and mother-of-three in her 40s.

Until recently, Layla — who didn't want DW to use her full name for security reasons — was living in Damascus , Syria's capital . She and her family are Alawites , the same religious sect as former Syrian dictator Bashar Assad , who are often targeted because they're seen as Assad's allies.

"But we never supported him, his father killed members of my family. We hated him actually," she told DW. Still, she describes feeling fearful when rebel groups entered Damascus in 2024 for the first time after the fall of the Assad regime, calling them "extremists."

At first, she and her husband decided to stay in Syria. But then a stranger came to the door.

"He told me 'we know your daughter plays piano and has dance lessons. You should stop that. If you don't, maybe we will take her to the house of the sisters," Layla recounts.

In conservative Islamic circles, women playing music and dancing for an audience is frowned upon. And Layla had heard about the so-called "house of the sisters" — she had read online it was a place where Syrian women from other sects were forced to convert to Islam. A few days later, the family decided to leave the country. They are now in Lebanon.

Headlines about the "house of sisters" first really made waves in Syria in May after an Alawite university student Batoul Alloush, 21, was reported missing by her family, possibly kidnapped, only to turn up later wearing religious clothing and saying she left her family in order to convert to Islam.

There were already other stories of missing women , including from the Alawite minority. 

Reham Suleiman, a psychologist who works for the United Nations and with the Alawite community, told DW she has firsthand knowledge of several cases of kidnapping. "And it’s not just one incident or coincidence," she says. It is clear some of women were kidnapped for ransom money, revenge or forced marriage.

But other cases were apparently resolved when, for example, the women said they had been visiting friends, wanted to escape their families or had run away to a lover. Alloush herself said she wished to convert to Islam and leave her family. Her parents insist she's been drugged or coerced.

Organizations like Amnesty International and the UN's Commission of Inquiry on Syria say the cases — which number between 40 and 60 ­­— have not been fully investigated.

Syrian authorities did look into the "house of sisters." A...
body.zh: 有传言称，“姐妹之家”是叙利亚其他教派被绑架的妇女被迫皈依伊斯兰教的地方。没有人知道它是否真的存在，但无论如何它都被用来制造公共紧张局势。 40 多岁的数学老师、三个孩子的母亲莱拉 (Layla) 说，有人敲门，一声无声的威胁，然后他们就决定离开这个国家。 直到最近，莱拉——出于安全原因不希望德国之声使用她的全名——一直住在叙利亚首都大马士革。她和她的家人都是阿拉维派，与前叙利亚独裁者巴沙尔·阿萨德属于同一教派，他们经常成为攻击目标，因为他们被视为阿萨德的盟友。 “但我们从不支持他，他的父亲杀了我的家人。我们实际上恨他，”她告诉德国之声。尽管如此，她描述了当阿萨德政权倒台后，2024 年反叛组织首次进入大马士革时，她感到恐惧，并称他们为“极端分子”。 起初，她和丈夫决定留在叙利亚。但就在这时，一个陌生人找上门来。 “他告诉我，‘我们知道你的女儿弹钢琴，还上舞蹈课。你应该停止这样做。如果你不这样做，也许我们会带她去姐妹家，”蕾拉回忆道。 在保守的伊斯兰圈子里，女性为观众演奏音乐和跳舞是不受欢迎的。莱拉听说过所谓的“姐妹之家”——她在网上读到，这是一个来自其他教派的叙利亚妇女被迫皈依伊斯兰教的地方。几天后，一家人决定出国。他们现在在黎巴嫩。 有关“姐妹之家”的头条新闻第一次真正在叙利亚引起轰动是在5月，当时21岁的阿拉维派大学生巴图尔·阿卢什(Batoul Alloush)被家人报告失踪，可能是被绑架，后来却穿着宗教服装出现，并说她离开家人是为了皈依伊斯兰教。 已经有其他女性失踪的故事，其中包括来自阿拉维派少数群体的女性。 为联合国和阿拉维派社区工作的心理学家雷哈姆·苏莱曼 (Reham Suleiman) 告诉德国之声，她掌握了多起绑架案件的第一手资料。 “这不仅仅是一次事件或巧合，”她说。显然，一些妇女是为了勒索赎金、报复或强迫婚姻而被绑架的。 但其他案件显然得到了解决，例如，当这些妇女说她们正在拜访朋友、想要逃离家人或逃往情人身边时。 阿卢什本人表示，她希望皈依伊斯兰教并离开家人。她的父母坚称她是被下药或被胁迫的。 国际特赦组织和联合国叙利亚调查委员会等组织表示，这些案件（数量在 40 至 60 起）尚未得到充分调查。 叙利亚当局确实调查了“姐妹之家”。一个...

reflection.en: Fear and suspicion, fueled by rumor, can drive families from their homes and fracture communities. The 'house of sisters' is a phantom, yet its imagined existence sows real terror and division. In such times, the call to speak for the vulnerable and defend the rights of the oppressed becomes even more urgent.
reflection.zh: 恐惧和猜疑，在谣言的煽动下，能够迫使家庭离开家园，分裂社群。“姐妹之家”只是一个虚影，但它所造成的想象中的存在却播下了真实的恐惧和分裂。在这样的时代，为弱者发声、捍卫受压迫者的权利的呼召变得更加迫切。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.zh: 加拿大称其可以在没有美国的情况下“转型并繁荣”。但代价是什么？

summary.en: Canada and the US have "arguably the most interconnected trade" in the world — and tariffs will likely hit those in the middle. The escalating trade war between the United States and Canada could cause mass layoffs across North America, as the long-term allies find themselves "at serious odds". Canada matched the US...
summary.zh: 加拿大和美国拥有“可以说是世界上联系最紧密的贸易”，而关税可能会打击中间群体。美国和加拿大之间不断升级的贸易战可能导致整个北美地区大规模裁员，因为这两个长期盟友发现自己“严重分歧”。加拿大对价值200亿美元（277亿加元）的美国商品征收高达50%的关税，以回应美国上个月对加拿大商品征收的同等关税。双方的谈判已经破裂，没...

body.en:
The escalating trade war between the United States and Canada could cause mass layoffs across North America, as the long-term allies find themselves "at serious odds".

The latest round of retaliatory tariffs took effect overnight, as Canada matched the US by imposing levies of up to 50 per cent on US$20 billion ($27.7 billion) worth of US goods.

The Canadian levies follow 50 per cent tariffs the US imposed on some US$20 billion ($27.7 billion) of Canadian goods last month , after several rounds of negotiations collapsed, with no new talks scheduled.

The breakdown has widened a rift between the longtime allies, both of whom have blamed the other for the failed talks, as the 18-month-old trade war intensifies.

But the costs could go beyond economics, as the countries have historically relied on close trade and supply-chain ties.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

As former US ambassador to Canada David Cohen explained, many products, such as motor vehicles, cross the two countries' borders several times during the manufacturing process.

"The trade relationship between the United States and Canada is arguably the most interconnected trade relationship anywhere in the world," he told ABC Radio National on Wednesday morning.

The "people getting hurt" are not the leaders of Canada and the US, he added, but small and medium-sized businesses getting "caught in the middle".

On Monday, US President Donald Trump said on social media that Canadian private jet maker Bombardier would no longer be allowed to sell its planes in the US unless it started manufacturing in the country, without saying whether an official government order would follow.

While Bombardier is owned by Canada, the company employs more than 1,000 US workers in Kansas and works with US companies across 47 states.

Blocking this manufacturing is a "clear example" of the two countries' interconnectedness, Cohen said, as an attempt to punish Canada will also affect US workers.

"In a trade war, the only people being hurt are small businesses and individual employees in both Canada and the United States. That can't go on. We have to find a resolution to it," Cohen said.

Jessica Genauer, an expert in international conflict and international relations at the University of NSW, said recent animosity stems back to Trump's first term as president and has been reignited.

"What we're seeing now is a much more fractious, deep-seated antagonism that's starting to emerge," she told SBS News.

Comments made by Trump that undermine Canada's sovereignty and national identity, such as referring to the country as a 51st state of the US, have been "particularly egregious" to Canadians.

reflection.en: The escalating trade war between Canada and the US, marked by retaliatory tariffs and collapsed negotiations, illustrates the difficulty of maintaining peace between close allies. Even as nations assert their independence, the call to 'live at peace with everyone' remains a challenge, urging us to seek reconciliation over conflict.
reflection.zh: 加拿大和美国之间不断升级的贸易战，以报复性关税和谈判破裂为标志，说明了在亲密盟友之间维持和平的困难。即使国家宣称独立，‘与众人和睦’的呼召仍然是一个挑战，促使我们寻求和解而非冲突。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.

title.en: Fine art thieves nab two 'priceless' Renoir paintings from French museum
title.zh: 法国博物馆两幅“无价”雷诺阿画作被盗艺术品大盗落网

summary.en: Two thieves stole two Renoir paintings from a museum on the French Riviera on Tuesday. Local authorities described the robbery as a "wake-up call" regarding the protection of fine art.
summary.zh: 周二，两名窃贼在法国里维埃拉的一家博物馆盗走了两幅雷诺阿的画作。当地官员称此次盗窃是对艺术品展示和保护方式的一次“警钟”。

body.en:
Two thieves stole two Renoir paintings from a museum on the French Riviera on Tuesday.

Local authorities said the pair broke in shortly before 6 am (2 pm AEST) by cutting a hole in a garden fence and entering through a window.

The stolen paintings by Pierre-Auguste Renoir, whose most valuable works have fetched dozens of millions of dollars at auctions, were Madame Colonna Romano and Young Woman at the Well. Both belong to Paris' famous Orsay Museum and were on loan to the museum.

The thieves had taken two more paintings, Madame Pichon and Coco Reading, a portrayal of Claude, the young son of the famous Impressionist artist, but dropped them in the gardens as police, alerted by alarms, arrived and gave chase, local mayor Bryan Masson and the Marseille prosecutor's office said.

Masson said of the paintings, "They are priceless; you cannot sell them just like that."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The Marseille prosecutor added that an investigation had been opened into theft by an organised gang.

The museum, set up in 1960 in Renoir's mansion on a hill near Nice where he died in 1919, had 13 paintings by the master on display and some 40 sculptures, items of furniture and photographs.

Masson, a member of the far-right National Rally (RN) party, called for greater security for museums around France.

"This incident should serve as a wake-up call about the protection of our museums, which are now facing a new form of crime targeting works of art," he said.

The French government has come under pressure to tackle dramatic failures in the security of the country’s museums.

A French parliamentary report this summer said museums lacked resources and were ill-prepared to safeguard precious artworks and cultural artefacts.

A culture ministry survey in 2024 found that only one in four institutions had an emergency and risk-prevention plan, and nearly half lacked any video surveillance.

Art thieves in Europe are committing more violent robberies, and specialist gangs have been replaced by ad hoc opportunists recruited through social media, pan-European police body Europol said last month.

It cited a heist at the Louvre Museum in Paris in October last year as a prime example. Other French museums were also targeted in the past months.

"They are attacking all museums now, we must react," Luc, a neighbour of the Renoir museum, told BFM TV.

body.zh: 周二，两名小偷从法国里维埃拉的一家博物馆偷走了两幅雷诺阿的画作。 地方当局称，两人在早上 6 点（澳大利亚东部时间下午 2 点）前不久，在花园栅栏上挖了一个洞，然后从窗户进入。 皮埃尔·奥古斯特·雷诺阿最有价值的作品在拍卖会上以数千万美元成交，被盗的画作是《科隆纳·罗马诺夫人》和《井边的年轻女子》。这两件作品均属于巴黎著名的奥赛博物馆，并被该博物馆借出。 当地市长布莱恩·马森(Bryan Masson)和马赛检察官办公室表示，窃贼又拿走了两幅画作《皮尚夫人》(Madame Pichon)和《可可·雷丁》(Coco Reading)，画的是著名印象派艺术家的小儿子克洛德(Claude)，但当警察接到警报后赶到并追赶时，窃贼把它们扔到了花园里。当地市长布莱恩·马森(Bryan Masson)和马赛检察官办公室表示。 马森谈到这些画作时说：“它们是无价的；你不能就这样卖掉它们。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 马赛检察官补充说，已对一个有组织团伙的盗窃行为展开调查。 该博物馆建于 1960 年，位于雷诺阿位于尼斯附近一座小山上的宅邸，雷诺阿于 1919 年在尼斯去世，馆内展出了这位大师的 13 幅画作以及约 40 件雕塑、家具和照片。 马森是极右翼国家集会党 (RN) 的成员，他呼吁加强法国各地博物馆的安全。 他说：“这一事件应该为我们的博物馆的保护敲响警钟，我们的博物馆现在面临着一种针对艺术品的新形式的犯罪​​。” 法国政府面临着解决该国博物馆安全方面严重失误的压力。 今年夏天的一份法国议会报告称，博物馆缺乏资源，而且在保护珍贵艺术品和文化文物方面准备不足。 文化部2024年的一项调查发现，只有四分之一的机构制定了应急和风险防范计划，近一半的机构没有视频监控。 泛欧警察机构欧洲刑警组织上个月表示，欧洲的艺术品窃贼正在实施更加暴力的抢劫，专业团伙已被通过社交媒体招募的临时机会主义者所取代。 它以去年十月巴黎卢浮宫博物馆发生的抢劫案为例。过去几个月，其他法国博物馆也成为攻击目标。 雷诺阿博物馆的邻居吕克告诉 BFM 电视台：“他们现在正在袭击所有博物馆，我们必须做出反应。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The audacious theft of two Renoir masterpieces, valued in the millions, speaks to the human heart's susceptibility to coveting what is not theirs. The pursuit of such 'treasures' often leads down paths of deceit and illegality, ultimately bringing no lasting good, as the proverb warns that dishonest scales are an abomination to Yahweh.
reflection.zh: 盗窃两幅价值连城的雷诺阿杰作，揭示了人心对不属于自己的东西的贪婪。对这些“珍宝”的追求常常导致欺骗和非法行为，最终不会带来任何持久的好处，正如箴言所警示的，不公的秤是雅伟所憎恶的。

title.en: Saudi oil sites hit as Houthi attacks intensify amid US-Iran fighting
title.zh: 沙特石油设施遭袭，胡塞武装袭击加剧，美伊冲突升级

summary.en: Yemen's Iranian-backed Houthi rebels attacked four cities in southern Saudi Arabia, injuring over 70 people and setting oil facilities ablaze. Simultaneously, explosions were reported at Iran's major oil hub and in the Gulf of Oman, suggesting a potential resumption of US strikes.
summary.zh: 也门受伊朗支持的胡塞武装周二袭击了沙特阿拉伯南部四个城市，造成70多人受伤，并点燃了石油设施。与此同时，据伊朗媒体报道，伊朗主要石油枢纽哈尔格岛以及阿曼湾的杰斯克港也发生爆炸，表明美国可能在美国与伊朗的冲突暂停两天后恢复了打击行动。

body.en:
Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels attacked four cities in southern Saudi Arabia, a US ally, on Tuesday, injuring more than 70 people and setting oil facilities ablaze in what appeared to be a significant escalation of the six-month-old conflict in the Middle East.

At the same time, explosions were reported on Kharg Island, Iran's major oil hub, and in the Gulf of Oman port of Jask, according to Iranian media, suggesting that US strikes against Iran may have resumed following a two-day pause.

Iranian news agency Tasnim reported that a US missile hit an Iranian tanker approximately 6 kilometres from Kharg Island. The vessel’s crew was reportedly being evacuated, although no casualties were reported, citing local sources.

The Pentagon did not immediately comment on the reports. However, a Fox News reporter, citing unidentified senior US officials, said the strikes were carried out by the US military.

In Saudi Arabia, the Houthis, who control most of Yemen's populated areas including the capital, said they had launched a broad operation deep into Saudi territory.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They used drones and missiles to strike a Saudi airbase in the southern city of Khamis Mushait as well as Saudi state oil company assets in the cities of Abha, Najran and Jazan.

NASA satellite images showed a thick cloud of black smoke over the Jazan refinery and a column of white smoke rising from an oil distribution centre in Abha.

Saudi authorities described blazes at the sites and said women and children were among the 73 people hurt.

The reports of such large numbers of wounded suggested the attacks were among the biggest carried out against Saudi Arabia since the US and Israel launched their war against Iran in February.

No confirmed images from the ground of the attacked Saudi cities were available, and witnesses could not be reached in a country where media is tightly controlled.

After a month of calm in August, fighting in the Gulf has resumed, with Iran and the US exchanging fire, sending global oil prices back towards the US$100 ($138.5) a barrel level passed at the war's peak.

Prices for benchmark Brent crude and US West Texas Intermediate rose and were on track for their highest closes since 23 July.

Houthi attacks on southwestern Saudi Arabia have the potential to worsen the war's global economic impact by disrupting Middle East energy supplies beyond the blockaded Strait of Hormuz.

Saudi Arabia has led an Arab coalition battling against the Houthis in Yemen for more than a decade. That war had calmed in recent years, but a ceasefire there has broken down, with the Houthis threatening shipping at the mouth of the Red Sea.

title.en: 'Absolute nightmare': Mass flight cancellations in the UK prompt calls for dismissals
title.zh: “简直是噩梦”：英国大规模航班取消引发解雇呼声

summary.en: Nearly 1,100 flights to and from UK airports were cancelled overnight due to a 'system issue'.
summary.zh: 由于“系统问题”，英国机场往返的近1100个航班在夜间被取消。

body.en:
Consumer chaos has descended on the UK's busiest airports as an air traffic glitch causes major disruptions, prompting calls to fire the head of the air traffic control service.

Almost 1,100 flights to and from UK airports were cancelled Tuesday, due to what the country's air traffic control service called a technical issue, in this latest error.

A total of 1,055 flights to and from British airports had been axed by 8pm (5am AEST) according to the aircraft tracking website FlightRadar24.

"Recovery from today's system issue has taken longer than we had hoped," Britain's air traffic control service, known as NATS, said on social media.

"Our system issue is now resolved, we are operating normally and working as hard as possible to clear the backlog of flights," it noted, adding "this is hugely frustrating and apologise unreservedly".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Tuesday's issues follow a technical glitch in July last year that saw scores of flights to and from the UK cancelled and which prompted anger from airline chiefs.

Britain saw its worst air systems failure in years in 2023, with more than 700,000 passengers affected after hundreds of flights were delayed or cancelled.

Heathrow Airport, Britain's largest and busiest airport, in west London, confirmed it was among those affected on Tuesday, along with Gatwick to the south of the UK capital.

"It's just an absolute nightmare down there," healthcare worker Josie Donoghue said of Gatwick after leaving the airport, having had to disembark her flight to Ireland after three hours stuck on the runway.

"Getting through that airport was like trying to get out of Alcatraz," she told Britain's domestic Press Association news agency.

Liverpool, Birmingham and Edinburgh airports were also affected, while Dublin Airport in Ireland said it had cancelled dozens of flights.

British Airways said it had to cancel or divert more than 100 flights, affecting tens of thousands of its customers.

Irish no-frills carrier Ryanair said more than 65,000 passengers had been disrupted and it had cancelled more than 50 flights.

Arsenal, due to play Napoli in the Champions League on Wednesday in the southern Italian city, were forced to cancel a press conference ahead of the match after the team's flight was delayed.

UK transport secretary Heidi Alexander said on X she was "seeking assurances that lessons will be learned and systems that support aviation are up to the job".

But Ryanair COO Neal McMahon repeated his calls for NATS chief executive Martin Rolfe to be fired, accusing him of having again "failed UK travellers".

body.en: Musician is also rattled to find her appearance gets far more attention than her playing in this reflective documentary from Lorna Tucker As well as her film about her own difficult teenage years , British director Lorna Tucker is probably best known for her documentaries on famous women with big personalities: Vivienne Westwood ( Westwood: Punk, Icon, Activist ), Katharine Hepburn (Call Me Kate) and Greta Garbo ( Garbo: Where Did You Go? ). Her latest subject, pianist Yuja Wang, is another high-achiever – but not someone with quite the same name recognition unless you’re a devotee of classical music, a field in which she is ranked among the very best alive. Wang certainly has a flamboyant side, expressed in her highly expressive, virtuoso performances and her sartorial style on stage. In fact some shocking pull quotes illustrate how her dress sense has been bizarrely over-examined in the press; she has been likened to a stripper for her outfits, and the New Yorker, of all publications, once described her as “fat” , which hardly seems germane to any discussion of her ability to play Tchaikovsky or Ligeti. But Wang’s biography and the texture of her daily life are very different from that of Tucker’s previous subjects. She was a child prodigy from an artistic Beijing family who came of age just in time to break records for views on YouTube. Sure, her life here looks glamorous in one way, with a lush New York apartment she barely ever sees because she’s constantly on the road. But her life is also one of perpetual practice and striving for perfection, the loneliness of the long-distance soloist. It’s a regimen that leaves almost no time for relationships or family, or even many friendships with peers who understand what she is going through – apart from a few mentors or collaborators such as fellow pianist Emanuel Ax or composer Teddy Abrams, with whom she recently won a Grammy. Still, she comes across as an effervescent character, intellectually curious and deeply attuned to the music she plays. Continue reading...
body.zh: 音乐家还惊讶地发现，在洛娜·塔克 (Lorna Tucker) 的这部反思性纪录片中，她的外表比她的演奏受到更多关注。除了她关于自己艰难的青少年时期的电影外，英国导演洛娜·塔克 (Lorna Tucker) 最出名的可能是她关于具有大个性的著名女性的纪录片：维维安·韦斯特伍德 (维维安·韦斯特伍德) (韦斯特伍德：朋克、偶像、激进分子)、凯瑟琳·赫本 (叫我凯特) 和葛丽泰·嘉宝 (嘉宝：你去哪儿了？)。她最新的对象钢琴家王羽佳是另一位成就斐然的人，但除非你是古典音乐的爱好者，否则她的知名度不会很高，而她在古典音乐领域被列为当今最优秀的音乐爱好者之一。王确实有华丽的一面，这体现在她极具表现力、精湛的表演和舞台上的服装风格上。事实上，一些令人震惊的引述说明了媒体如何奇怪地过度审视了她的着装品味。她因服装而被比作脱衣舞娘，所有出版物中的《纽约客》曾将她描述为“胖子”，这似乎与她扮演柴可夫斯基或利盖蒂的能力的任何讨论都没有关系。但王的传记和她的日常生活质感与塔克之前的主题有很大不同。她是来自北京一个艺术家庭的神童，成年后正好打破了 YouTube 上的观看次数记录。当然，她在这里的生活在某种程度上看起来很迷人，她几乎从未见过纽约的一套豪华公寓，因为她经常在路上。但她的生活也是一种不断练习和追求完美的生活，一种长距离独奏者的孤独。这种生活方式几乎没有时间留给人际关系或家庭，甚至没有时间与理解她正在经历的事情的同龄人建立友谊——除了一些导师或合作者，比如钢琴家伊曼纽尔·阿克斯(Emanuel Ax)或作曲家泰迪·艾布拉姆斯(Teddy Abrams)，她最近与他们一起赢得了格莱美奖。尽管如此，她仍然给人一种热情洋溢的感觉，求知欲强，对她演奏的音乐有着深刻的理解。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary offers a glimpse into the life of pianist Yuja Wang, showcasing her intense dedication and intellectual curiosity in the demanding world of classical music. Her commitment to mastering her art, even when facing external distractions like undue attention to her appearance, speaks to a deep-seated passion for her calling. Colossians 3:23...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片让我们得以一窥钢琴家王羽佳的生活，展现了她在古典音乐这个要求严苛的领域中，她那份强烈的奉献精神和求知欲。即使面对外表受到不当关注等外部干扰，她仍致力于精进技艺，这体现了她对自己使命的深切热情。 歌罗西书 3:23 提醒我们：“无论做什么，都要从心里去做，像是为主做的，不像为人做的。”...

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Hong Kong's first leader after British handover dies
title.zh: 香港首任特首、英国移交后首位领导人董建华逝世

summary.en: Tung Chee-hwa, the first chief executive of Hong Kong after its handover from British to Chinese rule, has died at the age of 89. His time in office, from 1997 to 2005, was characterized by significant challenges including the Asian Financial Crisis, two epidemics, and major protests.
summary.zh: 香港首任行政长官董建华（在英国将香港移交中国后）于周二晚逝世，享年89岁。他在1997年至2005年任职期间，经历了亚洲金融危机、两次重大疫情以及大规模抗议活动等严峻挑战。

body.en:
Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong's first leader after the city returned to Chinese rule, has died at the age of 89.

The former shipping scion took over the reins from the last British Governor Chris Patten in July 1997 when the UK handed Hong Kong back to China , ending more than 150 years of British control.

Tung's rocky tenure was marked by the Asian Financial Crisis, two major epidemics, and historic protests which attracted criticism of his administration. He eventually resigned in 2005.

Tung died on Tuesday night surrounded by loved ones, local media reported. His office described him as a man "devoted to his country and its people".

Born in Shanghai in 1937, Tung graduated with a mechanical engineering degree from Liverpool University in the UK before moving to the US, where he worked at General Electric for almost a decade.

In 1969, he moved to Hong Kong and worked in his father's shipping conglomerate, the Orient Overseas, eventually taking over the reins in 1979.

His political career began in 1992 when he was appointed a member of Patten's executive council.

Despite having little political experience, Tung was believed to be handpicked by Beijing to lead Hong Kong after the handover. He was seen as a loyalist, especially after China's state-run banks helped rescue his family business during a global slump in the mid-1980s.

During a reception at the Great Hall of the People in January 1996, China's then-president Jiang Zemin walked across a packed room to shake Tung's hands – a widely photographed gesture that at the time famously signalled Beijing's backing of Tung for the top job.

The Asian Financial Crisis hit shortly after Tung took over, which sent home prices diving. His administration was also beset by a series of public health challenges, including a bird flu outbreak from 1997 to 2002 and the 2003 outbreak of Sars, also known as Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome.

But Tung's biggest political challenge took place in July 2003 during his second term, when half a million Hongkongers took to the streets to protest against a proposed national security law they feared would threaten their civic rights.

His administration abandoned the proposed legislation following the massive outcry, which also contributed to Tung stepping down in March 2005.

At the time his declining health was cited as a reason - but some said he was pressured by Beijing to step down.

Beijing ultimately imposed a national security law on Hong Kong in 2020, which authorities have argued is necessary to maintain stability. Critics however have called it "the end of Hong Kong" and say it has created a climate of fear in the city.

Tung's last public outing was in July 2021, at an event marking the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Chinese Communist Party. He...
body.zh: 香港回归中国后的首任领导人董建华去世，享年89岁。 1997 年 7 月，英国将香港交还给中国，结束了英国 150 多年的控制，这位前航运业子弟从最后一任英国总督彭定康 (Chris Patten) 手中接过了权力。 亚洲金融危机、两次重大流行病以及引发对其政府批评的历史性抗议活动，标志着董建华的任期充满坎坷。他最终于2005年辞职。 据当地媒体报道，董于周二晚上在亲人的陪伴下去世。他的办公室形容他是一个“献身于他的国家和人民”的人。 董先生 1937 年出生于上海，毕业于英国利物浦大学，获得机械工程学位，随后移居美国，在通用电气工作了近十年。 1969年，他移居香港，在其父亲的航运集团东方海外工作，最终于1979年接手大权。 他的政治生涯始于1992年，当时他被任命为彭定康行政委员会成员。 尽管董建华缺乏政治经验，但据信是北京精心挑选的，在香港回归后领导香港。他被视为忠诚者，特别是在 20 世纪 80 年代中期全球经济衰退期间，中国国有银行帮助拯救了他的家族企业之后。 1996 年 1 月，在人民大会堂举行的招待会上，时任中国国家主席江泽民走过挤满人的房间，与董建华握手，这一举动被广泛拍照，在当时标志着北京支持董建华担任国家主席。 董建华上任后不久，亚洲金融危机袭来，房价暴跌。他的政府还受到一系列公共卫生挑战的困扰，包括1997年至2002年爆发的禽流感和2003年爆发的非典（又称严重急性呼吸系统综合症）。 但董建华最大的政治挑战发生在他的第二个任期内的 2003 年 7 月，当时 50 万香港人走上街头抗议一项拟议的国家安全法，他们担心这会威胁到他们的公民权利。 在遭到强烈抗议后，他的政府放弃了拟议的立法，这也导致董建华于 2005 年 3 月下台。 当时他的健康状况恶化被认为是一个原因，但也有人说他是受到北京方面的压力才下台的。 北京最终于 2020 年对香港实施了国家安全法，当局认为这是维持稳定所必需的。然而，批评者称其为“香港的终结”，并称这在这座城市造成了恐惧气氛。 董建华最后一次公开露面是在 2021 年 7 月的中国共产党成立 100 周年纪念活动上。他...

reflection.en: The news of Tung Chee-hwa's passing invites reflection on leadership and public service. Micah 6:8 calls for acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with God. Leaders, like Tung, face immense pressures and complex decisions, and the measure of their tenure often lies in how they sought to balance these divine imperatives amidst crises.
reflection.zh: 董建华先生的逝世，引人深思领导力与公共服务。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与雅伟同行。像董先生这样的领导者，在任期内面临巨大的压力和复杂的抉择，他们任职期间的成效，往往体现在如何在危机中努力平衡这些神圣的原则。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: How Mao Zedong's legacy still shapes China 50 years on
title.zh: 毛泽东的遗产如何至今仍在塑造中国

summary.en: Fifty years after Mao Zedong's death, China has undergone significant transformation. However, his legacy persists, influencing current leadership under Xi Jinping and fueling a resurgence of Maoist nostalgia among younger generations.
summary.zh: 毛泽东逝世五十年来，中国发生了翻天覆地的变化。然而，他的遗产依然存在，影响着习近平领导下的当今政权，并在年轻一代中引发了对毛泽东时代的新怀旧潮。

body.en:
China has transformed since Mao Zedong's death 50 years ago. But his legacy endures — from Xi Jinping's rule to a new wave of Mao nostalgia among young Chinese.

On September 9, 1976, Mao Zedong died. The revolutionary leader who led the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) to power and founded the People's Republic of China left behind a profoundly contradictory historical legacy.

He shaped the narratives of revolution, nation-building and national independence, but also left behind immense social trauma as a result of successive political campaigns and persecutions.

When Mao died, China was still a poor and relatively isolated communist state. Today, it is the world's second-largest economy, deeply embedded in the supply and value chains of global capitalism, with a vast private sector, a large urban middle class and a highly digitalized society. 

Zhang Lun, a professor at Cergy-Paris University, said Mao left behind four major political legacies: the authoritarian and highly centralized political system; a model of governance that relies on revolution and political campaigns to solve social problems; populist tendencies marked by anti-elitism and anti-rationalism; and utopian visions of egalitarianism and moralism.

From the perspective of political legacies, Zhang told DW, the most fundamental change in China over the past five decades has been "de-Maoization" — while its greatest challenge has been that this process was never fully completed.

Mao's name remains written into the CCP's constitution, while his thought remains part of China's official ideology and his portrait still hangs in Beijing's Tiananmen Square.

Mao helped forge the Chinese Communist Party, and his insistence on the party's supremacy over the state and society has remained a fundamental principle throughout the decades, said Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt, professor at the University of Zurich.

Veteran journalist and political commentator Chang Ping agrees, adding that what has truly endured is the institutional core of the principle that "the party leads everything," serving a state vision of being able to "concentrate resources to accomplish major tasks." 

The CCP, he said, can pursue such objectives "at all costs" — meaning the interests of ordinary people can be sacrificed to the maximum extent necessary to preserve the regime. 

Under current leader Xi Jinping , a number of political concepts and methods of governance associated with the Mao era — such as ideological unity and the spirit of "struggle" — have again attracted attention.

body.zh: 毛泽东逝世50年来，中国发生了翻天覆地的变化。但他的遗产依然存在——从习近平的统治到中国年轻人新一轮的毛泽东怀旧浪潮。 1976年9月9日，毛泽东逝世。 这位领导中国共产党夺取政权、建立中华人民共和国的革命领袖，留下了极其矛盾的历史遗产。 他塑造了革命、国家建设和民族独立的叙事，但也因连续的政治运动和迫害而留下了巨大的社会创伤。 毛泽东去世时，中国仍然是一个贫穷且相对孤立的共产主义国家。如今，它是世界第二大经济体，深深嵌入全球资本主义的供应链和价值链，拥有庞大的私营部门、庞大的城市中产阶级和高度数字化的社会。 巴黎塞尔吉大学教授张伦表示，毛泽东留下了四大政治遗产：专制和高度集权的政治制度；依靠革命和政治运动来解决社会问题的治理模式；以反精英主义和反理性主义为标志的民粹主义倾向；以及平等主义和道德主义的乌托邦愿景。 张向德国之声表示，从政治遗产的角度来看，中国过去50年最根本的变化是“去毛化”，而最大的挑战是这一过程从未完全完成。 毛泽东的名字仍然写进了中国共产党的党章，他的思想仍然是中国官方意识形态的一部分，他的肖像仍然悬挂在北京天安门广场上。 苏黎世大学教授吉恩·克里斯托弗·米特尔施塔特 (Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt) 表示，毛泽东帮助建立了中国共产党，几十年来，他坚持党对国家和社会的至高无上一直是一项基本原则。 资深记者、时事评论员常平对此表示赞同，并补充道，真正经久不衰的是“党领导一切”的制度核心，服务于“集中资源办好大事”的国家愿景。 他说，中共可以“不惜一切代价”追求这些目标——这意味着为了维护政权，可以最大限度地牺牲普通民众的利益。 在现任领导人习近平的领导下，一些与毛泽东时代相关的政治理念和执政方式——例如思想统一和“斗争”精神——再次引起人们的关注。 习近平的行动包括取消国家主席任期限制、加强他的个人权威以及纳入他的政治...

reflection.en: Mao Zedong's death 50 years ago marked a turning point for China, yet his ideological and political shadow continues to shape the nation. This enduring influence, from state narratives to popular nostalgia, speaks to the profound and often complex impact of historical figures. The story prompts reflection on how legacies, whether positive or negative, can...
reflection.zh: 毛泽东逝世五十周年标志着中国的一个转折点，但他的意识形态和政治影响至今仍在塑造着这个国家。这种从国家叙事到大众怀旧的持久影响，体现了历史人物深刻而复杂的作用。这个故事促使我们反思，无论正面还是负面，遗产如何能够持续并塑造现在，并提醒我们，不受约束的权力和野心可能带来长远甚至意想不到的后果。

verse.textEn: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.
verse.textZh: 骄傲在败坏以先；狂心在跌倒之前。

title.en: Another Australian found alive nearly two weeks after Nepal-Tibet floods
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水过后近两周，又一名澳大利亚人被发现生还

summary.en: An Australian citizen, previously unaccounted for after catastrophic flooding in Nepal, has been confirmed safe. This news brings relief to families anxiously awaiting word of their loved ones, though 35 Australians remain missing following the disaster last month which killed at least 1,399 people and left over 5,400...
summary.zh: 一名在尼泊尔失联的澳大利亚公民在灾难性洪水过后已被确认安全。这一消息为焦急等待亲人消息的家庭带来了宽慰，尽管上个月的灾难已造成至少1399人死亡、超过5400人失踪，仍有35名澳大利亚人下落不明。

body.en:
An Australian citizen who was in Nepal has been confirmed safe in the wake of the catastrophic flooding that swept through the region nearly two weeks ago.

The Australian was uncontactable but has today confirmed they are safe and well and do not require consular assistance, SBS News understands.

At least 1,399 people were killed by the 26 August mudslide and flooding in Nepal and Tibet and more than 5,400 are missing, including around 800 foreigners.

A group of Australian families with missing loved ones released a statement on Sunday, calling for greater transparency from tour groups and authorities.

They expressed gratitude to the Australian Federal Police and search teams working to find missing Australians, but criticised the Australian government for what they said was its failure to provide answers.

The federal government has sent a disaster assistance response team and other specialist resources to Kathmandu to assist with the search.

It has also committed $11 million to support the disaster response, which Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Monday was of national importance.

Hundreds of hydropower workers are among the missing, but the rescue of three of them from deep inside tunnels — two Nepalis on Friday and a Chinese man on Saturday — have buoyed hopes that more could still be alive.

At least 11 hydropower projects were engulfed when a glacier collapsed into a river on the Nepal-China border on August 26, burying the entrances to the tunnels of these projects under debris and mud and cutting off those trapped inside.

Authorities said Tuesday that rescuers in Nepal are focusing on three hydropower project tunnels where they believe dozens of workers could be trapped.

"Our search operation is focussed on finding survivors, including in tunnels. Our bigger focus is on the Chilime hydroelectric project, where we believe people are trapped, because there was a canteen, residency and arrangements for food," Dharma Raj Upreti, chief of the country's disaster authority, told Reuters.

Australian tunnel rescue expert Arnold Dix, who is advising Nepali teams, has said the operation presents an unprecedented challenge.

"Not one rescue, but multiple potential rescues, unfolding at the same time, in different places, each with its own dangers, uncertainties, and lives that may still be saved."
