The Medical Council on Tuesday presented its views on the government’s proposed amendments, which were first laid out in late June and aimed to speed up the watchdog’s process and accountability in handling...
body.zh: 香港医疗监管机构表示，没有必要设定处理投诉的目标时限，因为它对政府的一项提案提出了反驳，其中包括对其运营、纪律处分、内部监督和成员组成进行重大改革。医学委员会周二提出了对政府拟议修正案的看法，该修正案于 6 月下旬首次提出，旨在加快监管机构在处理……方面的流程和问责制。

reflection.en: The news highlights a tension between the desire for swift justice and the established procedures of a regulatory body. When processes become so slow that they fail to deliver timely accountability, it can lead to frustration and a sense of injustice for those seeking resolution. The prophet Habakkuk lamented a similar situation where justice seemed...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻凸显了对迅速伸张正义的渴望与监管机构既定程序之间的紧张关系。当程序变得过于缓慢，以至于无法及时问责时，可能会导致寻求解决之道的人们感到沮丧和不公。先知哈巴谷曾哀叹过类似的局面，当时正义似乎被扭曲和延迟，他呼喊说：“律法被废弃，公理也未能伸张。”

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: Buildings Dep’t launches 259 prosecutions over works at fire-hit Wang Fuk Court, 9 months after fatal blaze
title.zh: 王福苑火灾后九个月，屋宇署就失修单位展开259项检控

summary.en: Hong Kong's Buildings Department has initiated 259 prosecutions against four individuals and two companies responsible for renovation works at the fire-stricken Wang Fuk Court. The charges, filed over nine months after a deadly blaze killed 168 people, cite the use of substandard materials and inadequate supervision...
summary.zh: 香港屋宇署已对负责火灾中的王福苑单位翻新工程的四名个人和两家公司提起259项检控。这些指控在致命火灾造成168人死亡九个多月后提出，涉及使用劣质材料和翻新期间监督不力。

body.en: Hong Kong’s Buildings Department (BD) has launched more than 200 prosecutions against four individuals and two companies that oversaw renovation works at the fire-hit Wang Fuk Court. Wang Fuk Court. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The 259 charges, covering the use of defective or substandard materials and failure to adequately supervise renovation works, were initiated on Wednesday – more than nine months after the fire broke out. The prosecutions were launched after a joint investigation by the BD and the Housing Bureau’s Independent Checking Unit (ICU), the Wednesday statement said. The blaze at Wang Fuk Court, a government-subsidised housing estate in Tai Po, killed 168 people and displaced thousands of residents in November last year. Nine months on “The investigation revealed that the Registered Inspector (RI) employed by the project consultant failed to properly supervise the prescribed repair works and failed to ensure that the building was safe or had been rendered safe,” the department said on Wednesday “Meanwhile, during the course of the works, the main contractor and the project consultant allegedly permitted or authorised the use of non-fire-retardant scaffold netting and tarpaulins, as well as non-fire-retardant styrofoam boards to cover windows,” it continued. A tender analysis report signed off by Will Power director Wilson Ng in August 2023. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Fireproof windows along the emergency fire escape stairwell were also removed to create temporary access openings, causing smoke and fire to pour into the buildings and “ultimately resulting in 168 fatalities and 79 injuries,” the statement read. The two prosecuted companies are Will Power Architects, consultants for the estate’s HK$330 million renovation project, and the main contractor, Prestige Construction & Engineering. The four prosecuted individuals are Will Power’s director Wong Hap-yin and the inspector employed by the company, Wilson Ng, as well as Prestige’s two directors Hau Wa-kin and Ho Kin-yip. The same four people were also charged with a slew of offences in June, with Wong, Ng, Ho, and the two companies they represent facing manslaughter charges. ‘Widespread systemic issues’ Similar findings have previously been detailed in evidentiary hearings set up by an independent committee to probe the cause of the fire and its rapid spread. In March, the committee heard that the blaze revealed “ widespread systemic issues ” ranging from potential collusive tendering to rubber-stamp inspections and unauthorised proxy votes. The companies and the four individuals were discussed extensively at the hearings, though they did not testify in person. The blackened exterior of an apartment block in Wang Fuk Court, Tai Po, on November 27, 2025, with what appears...
body.zh: 香港屋宇署 (BD) 对负责监督遭受火灾的宏福苑翻修工程的四名个人和两家公司提起了 200 多项起诉。宏福苑.照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。这 259 项指控是在火灾发生九个多月后于周三发起的，涉及使用有缺陷或不合格的材料以及未能充分监督翻修工程。周三的声明称，屋宇署和房屋局独立审查组（ICU）联合调查后提出检控。去年11月，大埔政府资助住宅小区宏福苑发生火灾，造成168人死亡，数千居民流离失所。九个月后，该部门周三表示，“调查显示，项目顾问聘用的注册检验员（RI）未能适当监督规定的维修工程，未能确保建筑物安全或已达到安全状态。”“与此同时，在工程过程中，总承包商和项目顾问据称允许或授权使用非阻燃脚手架网和防水油布，以及非阻燃聚苯乙烯泡沫板来覆盖窗户，”该部门继续说道。 Will Power 董事 Wilson Ng 于 2023 年 8 月签署的招标分析报告。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。声明称，紧急逃生楼梯间沿线的防火窗也被拆除，以形成临时通道，导致烟雾和火灾涌入建筑物，“最终导致 168 人死亡、79 人受伤”。两家被起诉的公司分别是该屋村耗资3.3亿港元翻新工程的顾问公司Will Power Architects，以及总承包商Prestige Construction & Engineering。四名被检控人士分别为Will Power董事黄合贤、该公司聘用的督察吴伟信，以及Prestige两名董事侯华健及何建业。六月，这四人还被指控犯有一系列罪行，其中黄、吴、何以及他们代表的两家公司面临过失杀人罪指控。 “广泛的系统性问题”此前，一个独立委员会为调查火灾原因及其迅速蔓延而设立的证据听证会详细介绍了类似的调查结果。今年三月，委员会听说火灾暴露了“广泛的系统性问题”，从潜在的串通投标到橡皮图章检查和未经授权的代理投票。尽管这些公司和这四人没有亲自作证，但他们在听证会上进行了广泛讨论。 2025 年 11 月 27 日，大埔宏福苑一栋公寓楼的外墙被熏黑，看上去……

reflection.en: The tragedy at Wang Fuk Court, which claimed 168 lives, highlights a profound failure in accountability. The subsequent launch of 259 prosecutions points to a system grappling with the consequences of negligence and the use of substandard materials. This situation calls us to reflect on the importance of integrity and diligence in all our undertakings,...
reflection.zh: 王福苑的悲剧夺走了168条生命，这暴露了问责制的严重缺失。随后发起的259项检控表明，相关系统正在应对疏忽大意和使用劣质材料所带来的后果。这种情况促使我们反思，在所有事业中，尤其是在那些影响他人安全和福祉的事业中，诚信和勤勉的重要性。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Washington accuses Chinese AI firms of ‘systematic’ theft
title.zh: 华盛顿指控中国人工智能公司“系统性”盗窃

summary.en: Washington accused top Chinese artificial intelligence labs, including DeepSeek and Moonshot AI, of systematically stealing the capabilities of American models on Tuesday, amidst a race for technological supremacy between the two countries. This advisory from the US cyber defense agency precedes a potential meeting...
summary.zh: 周二，华盛顿指控包括 DeepSeek 和 Moonshot AI...

body.en: Washington accused top Chinese artificial intelligence labs including DeepSeek and Moonshot AI of systematically stealing the capabilities of American models on Tuesday as the two countries race for tech supremacy. Chinese startup DeepSeek’s AI assistant. File photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP. The advisory from the US cyber defense agency comes ahead of an expected meeting this month between President Donald Trump and his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping at the White House, where AI could be an important discussion topic. It follows several previous accusations of Chinese AI theft through a process known as distillation, levelled by the US government and American AI companies. “China-based artificial intelligence (AI) companies are conducting systematic extraction of proprietary functionalities and capabilities of US AI companies’ models,” Tuesday’s advisory read. They are doing so “through industrial-scale knowledge distillation campaigns that form the core — not merely a supplement — of their AI development strategy”, it said. OpenAI, the creator of ChatGPT. Photo: Levart_Photographer/Unsplash. Distillation is where an AI model is trained to mimic the output of a larger, more capable one. The method is widely used across the industry, but Washington says Chinese firms have deployed it at scale to illicitly copy American systems. Chinese companies that adopt this strategy “see significantly shorter AI development timelines and reduced financial expenditures in training a frontier model”, the advisory said. It detailed how DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, Alibaba, MiniMax, StepFun, and Z.AI allegedly used millions of exchanges and requests to steal the capabilities of US models from the likes of OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and xAI. These actions, taken “likely with Chinese government awareness”, have taken place since at least late 2024, it said. AFP contacted the Chinese companies apart from StepFun which was not immediately reachable. Moonshot AI declined to comment. ‘Smearing China’ Trump is under pressure to respond to the increasing success of Chinese AI models that many companies prefer to the more powerful, but pricier, US versions from Anthropic or OpenAI. In July, dozens of startups wrote a letter to the Trump administration urging it to think twice against any outright ban or strict curbs on foreign-made AI models, saying this should only be considered for government use of the technology. That month, Beijing also turned the tables by accusing US AI of using Chinese examples to train their models. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Beijing, China. Photo: Wikicommons. Asked about the accusations at a regular briefing Wednesday, Chinese foreign ministry spokeswoman Mao Ning said...
body.zh: 周二，在两国争夺技术霸主之际，华盛顿指责 DeepSeek 和 Moonshot AI 等中国顶尖人工智能实验室系统性窃取美国模型的能力。中国初创公司 DeepSeek 的人工智能助手。资料照片：Kelly Ho/HKFP。美国网络防御机构的这一建议是在唐纳德·特朗普总统和中国国家主席习近平预计本月在白宫举行会议之前发布的，人工智能可能成为重要的讨论话题。在此之前，美国政府和美国人工智能公司曾多次指控中国通过“蒸馏”过程盗窃人工智能。周二的咨询报告称：“中国的人工智能（AI）公司正在系统地提取美国人工智能公司模型的专有功能和能力。”报告称，他们正在“通过工业规模的知识提炼活动来实现这一目标，这些活动构成了其人工智能发展战略的核心，而不仅仅是补充”。 OpenAI，ChatGPT 的创建者。照片：Levart_Photographer/Unsplash。蒸馏是训练人工智能模型来模仿更大、能力更强的模型的输出。该方法在整个行业广泛使用，但华盛顿表示，中国公司已大规模部署该方法来非法复制美国系统。该咨询称，采用这一策略的中国公司“发现人工智能开发时间明显缩短，培训前沿模型的财务支出也减少了”。它详细介绍了 DeepSeek、Moonshot AI、阿里巴巴、MiniMax、StepFun 和 Z.AI 据称如何利用数百万次交换和请求从 OpenAI、Anthropic、谷歌和 xAI 等公司窃取美国模型的功能。报告称，这些行动“可能是在中国政府意识到的情况下”采取的，至少自 2024 年底以来就已采取。法新社联系了除StepFun之外的其他中国公司，但未能立即联系上。 Moonshot AI 拒绝置评。 “抹黑中国” 特朗普面临着应对中国人工智能模型日益成功的压力，许多公司更喜欢中国人工智能模型，而不是 Anthropic 或 OpenAI 的更强大但价格更高的美国版本。今年 7 月，数十家初创公司写信给特朗普政府，敦促其三思而后行，反对对外国制造的人工智能模型的任何彻底禁令或严格限制，并表示只有政府使用该技术才应考虑这样做。当月，北京还指责美国人工智能使用中国的例子来训练他们的模型，从而扭转了局势。位于中国北京的外交部。照片：维基共享资源。中国外交部发言人毛宁在周三的例行吹风会上被问及这些指控时表示……

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as highlighted by accusations of capability theft between nations, speaks to a time when 'knowledge will increase' (Daniel 12:4). This technological race, while fraught with ethical concerns and competition, also represents humanity's relentless pursuit of understanding and innovation. May we seek wisdom to...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，如国家间关于能力窃取的指控所示，正应验了“知识将增添”（但以理书 12:4）的预言。这场技术竞赛虽然充满伦理担忧和竞争，但也代表了人类对理解和创新的不懈追求。愿我们寻求智慧来引导这些强大的工具服务于人类的繁荣，而非加剧分裂。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Unidentified Murder review – playful sendup of alien abduction and true crime influencers in Hong Kong
title.zh: 《不明谋杀》评论——香港外星人绑架和真实犯罪网红的戏谑模仿

summary.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling. Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done...
summary.zh: 在这部突破叙事界限的低成本喜剧冒险片中，儿时好友声称目睹了一名学童的失踪。由郭嘉曦和李振杰执导的这部规模不大、结构精巧的喜剧，以一种随心所欲的戏谑方式模仿了真实犯罪爱好者和伪网红，但其出发点是喜爱而非恶意。影片围绕一个（虚构的）25年前的案件展开，该案件吸引了整个香港的关注。

body.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done with affection rather than malice. It revolves around a (fictional) 25-year-old case that captivates the whole of Hong Kong. Back when they were seven, childhood friends Mark (Ling Man-lung) and Kit (Ronald Lam Tsz-kit) claimed to have witnessed the abduction by aliens of their classmate Ho in the woods of Tung Tau Hill. On the 25th anniversary of this supposed incident, the pair re-enter the internet’s consciousness after an interview on an online chatshow about unsolved mysteries. Cashing in on their viral fame, Mark’s girlfriend Man (Renci Yeung) hires actor Kim (Peter Chan Charm-man) to pretend to be Ho, all in the hope of racking up views on her social channels. Just when the cameras are all set up, Man watches in horror as the staged reunion leads to a real murder … or does it? The film unfolds in a series of increasingly tricksy complications and reversals. All of a sudden, apparent victims are revealed to be scheming masterminds, and vice versa. As most of the actions take place in the forest where the abduction supposedly occurred, the plot derives comic relief from the increasingly blurred line between truth and playacting. Largely shot with handheld cameras, it has a visual style that lends authenticity to representations of online media, though occasionally this distracts from the physical comedy performed by the cast. The constant twists also turn into bit of a competitive sport, meaning the film becomes more of a writing exercise than anything else. Continue reading...
body.zh: 儿时的朋友声称在这部低成本喜剧中目睹了一名小学生的失踪，这部喜剧突破了讲故事的极限。郭家熙和李俊杰的这部喜剧规模适中，结构复杂，是对真正的犯罪爱好者和想要成为影响者的反复无常的讽刺，是出于感情而不是恶意。它围绕着一个（虚构的）25 年前震惊整个香港的案件展开。七岁时，青梅竹马的Mark（凌文龙饰）和Kit（林中基饰）声称在东头山的树林里亲眼目睹了同学何氏被外星人绑架。在这起所谓的事件发生 25 周年之际，两人在一次关于未解之谜的在线访谈节目中接受采访后，重新进入了互联网的视野。马克的女友曼（杨仁慈饰）利用他们的病毒名气，聘请演员金（陈可辛饰）假扮何浩，希望能在她的社交频道上获得更多的关注。就在摄像机全部架好时，曼惊恐地看着这场上演的重聚导致了一场真正的谋杀……是吗？影片在一系列日益棘手的复杂情况和逆转中展开。突然之间，表面上的受害者被揭露为诡计多端的策划者，反之亦然。由于大部分情节都发生在据称发生绑架的森林中，因此事实与表演之间的界限越来越模糊，情节因此而变得喜剧化。它主要是用手持摄像机拍摄的，其视觉风格为在线媒体的表现提供了真实性，尽管有时这会分散演员们表演的肢体喜剧的注意力。不断的曲折也变成了一场竞技运动，这意味着这部电影更像是一场写作练习。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This film playfully satirizes our fascination with true crime and the influencers who amplify these stories. In a world saturated with sensational narratives, Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, honorable, and excellent, rather than getting lost in speculation or manufactured drama. May we cultivate discernment in what we consume...
reflection.zh: 这部电影以一种戏谑的方式讽刺了我们对真实犯罪故事和放大这些故事的网红们的迷恋。在一个充斥着耸人听闻叙事的世界里，《腓立比书》4:8 提醒我们要将心思意念专注于真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事，而不是沉溺于猜测或人为制造的戏剧。愿我们培养辨别力，选择所消费和分享的内容，寻求真理与良善。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: Project digitally recreates a buried World War I battlefield
title.zh: 项目数字重现一战战场

summary.en: A project has digitally recreated a World War I battlefield, allowing researchers and the public to explore a German stronghold and trench fortress near Wijtschate, Belgium, captured during the 1917 Battle of Messines, through an immersive digital experience that includes historical artifacts and human stories.
summary.zh: 一个项目已对一战战场进行了数字化重现，让研究人员和公众能够通过身临其境的数字体验，探索位于比利时维奇特海附近的一个德军据点和战壕工事——该据点在1917年的梅西讷战役中被占领。该体验包含历史文物和人物故事。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Imagine walking through a World War I excavation site—not wading through mud-filled trenches, but navigating a digital landscape rich with history, artifacts and human stories.

The Applied Research in Immersive Experiences and Simulations (ARIES) team in University Libraries at Virginia Tech created an immersive digital experience that allows researchers and the public to explore Hill 80, a German stronghold and trench fortress near Wijtschate, Belgium, captured during the 1917 Battle of Messines.

Dig Hill 80 was a rescue archaeology project prompted by plans to build a housing development on the site. For generations, local residents had repeated the saying that "there is an army buried there," sparking interest in what might lie beneath the ground. Flemish archaeologist Simon Verdegem led the project, which was crowdfunded beginning in late 2017.

Enough funding was secured for the excavation to take place from mid-April to early June 2018. Archaeologists uncovered trench systems, dugouts, artifacts and soldier remains.

"The ground was fought over for nearly the entirety of the First World War," said Todd Ogle, executive director of ARIES.

"Evidence in the form of equipment and human remains was found from fighting during the very first months of the war all the way through the final German offensive in 1918. The volume of remains, combined with the level of preservation of the finds and the complex nature of the site, made it important to investigate and preserve the site before construction of the housing development in late 2018."

The ARIES team, along with experts in digital cultural preservation and history, visited Dig Hill 80 for a week in June 2018. They documented the excavation and began developing ways to preserve its artifacts, layout, context and human stories.

Today, the housing development covers the former excavation area. Its history, however, will remain available through an extensive digital archive. Rather than remaining a collection of digital records, the excavation became the starting point for something far more dynamic.

ARIES became involved with the Dig Hill 80 project through Ogle's scholarly work in cultural preservation and visualization of the past. It was a unique opportunity for Virginia Tech students to engage in authentic project-based, experiential learning work with real-world partners.

"The same skills that students use to develop simulations and entertainment are used in preservation projects like this one," said Ogle.

"The portfolio material students gained from this project helped them get jobs in engineering simulation,...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 想象一下，走过一战的挖掘现场——不是涉水穿过充满泥浆的战壕，而是在充满历史、文物和人类故事的数字景观中航行。 弗吉尼亚理工大学图书馆的沉浸式体验和模拟应用研究 (ARIES) 团队创建了一种沉浸式数字体验，让研究人员和公众能够探索 80 号山，这是比利时维特沙特附近的德国据点和战壕堡垒，在 1917 年梅西因战役中占领。 Dig Hill 80 是一个救援考古项目，由在该地点建造住房开发计划推动。几代人以来，当地居民一直重复着“那里埋着一支军队”的说法，引发了人们对地下埋藏着什么的兴趣。佛兰德考古学家 Simon Verdegem 领导了该项目，该项目于 2017 年底开始众筹。 挖掘工作已获得足够的资金，将于 2018 年 4 月中旬至 6 月初进行。考古学家发现了战壕系统、防空洞、文物和士兵遗骸。 ARIES 执行董事托德·奥格尔 (Todd Ogle) 表示：“第一次世界大战期间，几乎整个时期都在争夺这片土地。” “从战争最初几个月的战斗一直到 1918 年德国最后的进攻，都发现了设备和人体遗骸形式的证据。遗骸的数量，加上发现物的保存水平和遗址的复杂性，使得在 2018 年底建造住房开发之前调查和保护该遗址变得非常重要。” ARIES 团队与数字文化保护和历史专家一起于 2018 年 6 月参观了 Dig Hill 80 一周。他们记录了挖掘过程，并开始开发方法来保存其文物、布局、背景和人类故事。 如今，住房开发覆盖了以前的挖掘区域。然而，它的历史将通过广泛的数字档案得以保留。这次发掘不再是数字记录的集合，而是成为更具活力的事物的起点。 ARIES 通过 Ogle 在文化保护和过去可视化方面的学术工作参与了 Dig Hill 80 项目。对于弗吉尼亚理工大学的学生来说，这是一个独特的机会，可以与现实世界的合作伙伴一起参与真实的基于项目的体验式学习工作。 奥格尔说：“学生们用来开发模拟和娱乐的技能也被用于像这样的保护项目中。” “学生从这个项目中获得的作品集材料帮助他们找到了工程模拟领域的工作，......

reflection.en: In an age where information and technology accelerate, the ability to digitally reconstruct and explore historical sites like Hill 80 offers a unique way to connect with the past. This project allows us to learn from the human stories embedded in the artifacts, fostering understanding and remembrance.
reflection.zh: 在一个信息和技术飞速发展的时代，能够数字化地重建和探索像希尔80这样的历史遗址，为我们提供了与过去联系的独特方式。这个项目让我们能够从文物中蕴含的人物故事中学习，促进理解和缅怀。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: How we manage and engage with horses may shape their personality
title.zh: 我们如何管理和与马互动可能会塑造它们的个性

summary.en: A new study indicates that a horse's personality is influenced not only by genetics, age, or breed but also significantly by its living conditions, riding practices, care, and the quality of its relationship with its owner, highlighting the impact of human management on equine personality and welfare.
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，马的个性不仅受遗传、年龄或品种的影响，还与其生活条件、骑乘方式、护理以及与主人的关系质量密切相关，这凸显了人类管理对马的个性和福祉的影响。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A new study reveals that horse personality is not only a matter of genetics, age or breed but also systematically linked to how horses are housed, ridden and cared for, and to the quality of the relationship they share with their owners. The findings underscore the importance of everyday management decisions for equine personality and welfare.

Horse personality has long been known to influence welfare, training outcomes and the quality of human–horse interactions. While genetic and biological factors clearly play a role, far less has been known about how the human-shaped environment may contribute to building horse personality.

"Personality is not something that develops independently of its surroundings. Horses live in environments we create and relationships we build for them, and our results show that these matter," says lead author of the study, Postdoctoral Researcher Océane Liehrmann from the University of Turku, Finland, and the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences.

The research group conducted an international online survey during 2023–2024, gathering responses from 2,257 horse owners of about 2,767 horses across Europe, North America and beyond. Owners rated their horses' personalities using a 52-item questionnaire and provided detailed information about housing conditions, riding and groundwork frequency, quality time with their horses, headgear use, ownership history and relationship duration.

As expected, intrinsic factors such as age, sex and breed were among the strongest drivers of personality scores. Warmbloods, for example, scored highest in neuroticism, while draft horses scored lowest. Geldings consistently scored higher than mares in both human sociability and attentiveness.

The length and stability of the relationship were linked to human sociability: horses with the same owner for more than 10 years scored about 12% higher than those with an owner for less than a year, while horses that had passed through multiple owners scored lower than those bought directly from a breeder.

"These patterns suggest that familiarity and relational continuity contribute to how openly and comfortably horses engage with people. Frequent changes of owner or stable may leave a lasting mark on a horse's willingness to seek human contact," explains Liehrmann.

Owners who often spent unstructured time with their horses—being present, offering scratches and not demanding anything from them—had horses that scored higher on human sociability.

Meanwhile, riding frequency was tied to calmness: Horses ridden four to seven times a week scored higher on attentiveness...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 一项新的研究表明，马的性格不仅与遗传、年龄或品种有关，而且还与马的饲养、骑乘和照顾方式以及它们与主人的关系质量有系统的联系。研究结果强调了日常管理决策对马的个性和福利的重要性。 长期以来，人们都知道马的性格会影响福利、训练结果和人马互动的质量。虽然遗传和生物因素显然发挥了作用，但人们对人类环境如何有助于马的性格形成却知之甚少。 该研究的主要作者、芬兰图尔库大学和瑞典农业科学大学的博士后研究员 Océane Liehrmann 表示：“个性并不是独立于周围环境而发展的东西。马生活在我们创造的环境和我们为它们建立的关系中，我们的研究结果表明这些很重要。” 该研究小组在 2023 年至 2024 年期间进行了一项国际在线调查，收集了欧洲、北美及其他地区 2,257 名马主、约 2,767 匹马的反馈。主人使用包含 52 项的调查问卷对马匹的性格进行评分，并提供有关马舍条件、骑马和基础工作频率、与马匹共处的美好时光、头饰使用、拥有历史和关系持续时间的详细信息。 正如预期的那样，年龄、性别和品种等内在因素是人格得分的最强驱动因素。例如，温血马在神经质方面得分最高，而挽马得分最低。骟马在人类社交能力和注意力方面的得分始终高于母马。 这种关系的长度和稳定性与人类的社交能力有关：拥有同一主人超过10年的马匹得分比拥有同一主人不到一年的马匹得分高出约12％，而经过多个主人的马匹得分低于直接从饲养员那里购买的马匹。 “这些模式表明，熟悉度和关系的连续性有助于马与人的开放和舒适的互动。频繁更换主人或马厩可能会对马寻求人类接触的意愿留下持久的印记，”利尔曼解释道。 经常与马共度非结构化时间的主人——在场、提供抓痕、不向马提出任何要求——他们的马在人类社交能力方面得分更高。 与此同时，骑马频率与冷静程度有关：每周骑马四到七次的马在注意力方面得分更高......

reflection.en: The study reveals that the way we care for and interact with horses profoundly shapes their character. This echoes the wisdom found in observing creation, as Job suggests, that the natural world can teach us about the Creator and the creatures within it. Our stewardship and relationships matter, not just for the animals we care for, but as a reflection of...
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了我们照顾和与马互动的方式深刻地塑造了它们的品格。这呼应了约伯所提出的，从观察受造界中可以找到智慧，自然界能够教导我们关于造物主和其中生灵的道理。我们的管理和关系不仅对我们所照顾的动物很重要，也反映了我们自身的品格。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Physics-aware benchmark reveals why similar materials AI models can predict thermal conductivity differently
title.zh: 物理感知基准揭示了相似材料AI模型为何会不同地预测导热性

summary.en: AI models used to predict material properties like thermal conductivity can yield different results, even when analyzing similar materials. This discrepancy arises from how these models interpret the complex quantum-mechanical interactions of atoms and electrons, which govern material behavior. The challenge lies in...
summary.zh: 用于预测导热性等材料特性的AI模型，即使在分析相似材料时，也可能产生不同的结果。这种差异源于这些模型如何解释原子和电子之间复杂的量子力学相互作用，而这些相互作用决定了材料的行为。挑战在于准确捕捉这些相互作用，尤其是在微观层面，粒子的行为难以直接观察。

body.en: Material properties such as sound insulation, resistance to extreme heat and thermal expansion originate from how the zillions of microscopic building blocks (nuclei and electrons) interact at equilibrium and respond to perturbations. Atoms are typically about one ten-billionth of a meter across, so there can be a lot of parts to keep track of—a task that is complicated at the quantum-mechanical level, where particles are neither here nor there until observed.
body.zh: 隔音、耐热和热膨胀等材料特性源于无数微观构件（原子核和电子）在平衡状态下相互作用以及对扰动的响应。原子的直径通常约为十亿分之一米，因此可能有很多部分需要跟踪——这是一项在量子力学层面上很复杂的任务，在量子力学层面上，粒子在被观察之前既不存在，也不存在。

reflection.en: The pursuit of understanding material properties through AI models reflects a deep human drive to comprehend the intricate workings of creation. As these models grapple with the 'zillions of microscopic building blocks,' they echo the ancient wisdom that creation itself speaks volumes about its Maker's design and intelligence. May our scientific endeavors...
reflection.zh: 通过AI模型来理解材料特性的追求，反映了人类理解受造物复杂运作的深刻驱动力。当这些模型在处理“数万亿个微观构件”时，它们呼应了古老的智慧：受造物本身就充分说明了其创造者的设计和智慧。愿我们的科学探索永远以谦卑和对宇宙深邃秩序的惊奇感为指引。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: The Future We Choose: New Beyond Blue report explores the forces shaping the next decade of mental health in Australia
title.zh: 我们选择的未来：Beyond Blue 新报告探讨塑造澳大利亚未来十年心理健康的因素

summary.en: Beyond Blue has released 'The Future We Choose: Mental health support in Australia through the next decade of change,' a report by CSIRO that examines potential mental health trends in Australia over the next ten years and the choices that can foster a more robust, connected, and resilient future. Despite increased...
summary.zh: Beyond Blue 发布了《我们选择的未来：变革十年中的澳大利亚心理健康支持》报告，该报告由澳大利亚国家科学机构 CSIRO...

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Beyond Blue has launched " The Future We Choose: Mental health support in Australia through the next decade of change ," a new strategic foresight report by Australia's national science agency, CSIRO, exploring how mental health in Australia may evolve over the next decade and the choices that could help shape a stronger, more connected and resilient future.

While mental health awareness and literacy have improved and more Australians are seeking support than ever before, there is still a major help-seeking gap as demand continues to outpace supply. Workforce shortages, cost barriers and challenges accessing support continue.

At the same time, rapid social, technological, economic and environmental change is reshaping how people experience mental health and mental illness, seek support and access information, raising important questions about whether today's systems are equipped for the future.

Commissioned by Beyond Blue to mark its 25th year using CSIRO's strategic foresight methodology, the report examines the forces shaping the future of mental health in Australia. It presents four possible scenarios and identifies five shifts focused on prevention, community connection, trusted technology, easier navigation and earlier support to help Australia move from a system defined by crisis response toward one that is more preventive, connected, trusted and adaptive.

Beyond Blue Chair the Hon. Linda Dessau AC CVO said the report reflects Beyond Blue's commitment to helping Australia prepare for the future of mental health.

"For 25 years, Beyond Blue has helped lead national conversations about mental health, improving literacy, reducing stigma, providing novel service options and encouraging earlier support-seeking. Just as Beyond Blue helped change the conversation about mental health when it was founded, this report signals a new conversation about the future we want to create and the choices that will help us get there."

Beyond Blue CEO Georgie Harman AO said the report was designed to help Australia understand the choices that will shape mental health over the next decade.

"The conditions shaping mental health are changing rapidly, yet many of the challenges facing Australians today remain stubbornly familiar," Harman said.

"The Future We Choose highlights two uncertainties that will influence how mental health evolves in the next decade: whether technology becomes a trusted enabler of mental health and whether the relationships and support systems we rely on grow stronger or come under greater strain.

"By exploring these possibilities, the report reinforces the...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： Beyond Blue 推出了《我们选择的未来：未来十年变革中澳大利亚的心理健康支持》，这是澳大利亚国家科学机构 CSIRO 的新战略前瞻报告，探讨了澳大利亚的心理健康在未来十年将如何发展，以及有助于塑造更强大、联系更紧密、更有弹性的未来的选择。 尽管心理健康意识和素养有所提高，并且寻求支持的澳大利亚人比以往任何时候都多，但由于需求继续超过供应，寻求帮助仍然存在重大缺口。劳动力短缺、成本障碍和获得支持的挑战仍然存在。 与此同时，快速的社会、技术、经济和环境变化正在重塑人们体验心理健康和精神疾病、寻求支持和获取信息的方式，提出了当今的系统是否适合未来的重要问题。 该报告受 Beyond Blue 委托使用 CSIRO 的战略前瞻方法来纪念其使用 25 周年，该报告研究了塑造澳大利亚心理健康未来的力量。它提出了四种可能的情景，并确定了五项转变，重点是预防、社区联系、可信技术、更便捷的导航和早期支持，以帮助澳大利亚从以危机应对为导向的系统转向更具预防性、互联性、可信性和适应性的系统。 超越蓝色主席阁下。 Linda Dessau AC CVO 表示，该报告反映了 Beyond Blue 致力于帮助澳大利亚为心理健康的未来做好准备的承诺。 “25 年来，Beyond Blue 帮助引领了有关心理健康的全国性对话，提高了识字率，减少了耻辱感，提供了新颖的服务选择，并鼓励早期寻求支持。正如 Beyond Blue 在成立时帮助改变了有关心理健康的对话一样，这份报告也标志着一场关于我们想要创造的未来以及帮助我​​们实现目标的选择的新对话。” Beyond Blue首席执行官Georgie Harman AO表示，该报告旨在帮助澳大利亚了解未来十年将影响心理健康的选择。 哈曼说：“影响心理健康的条件正在迅速变化，但澳大利亚人今天面临的许多挑战仍然是司空见惯的。” “我们选择的未来强调了两个将影响心理健康在未来十年如何发展的不确定性：技术是否成为心理健康值得信赖的推动者，以及我们所依赖的关系和支持系统是否会变得更强大或面临更大的压力。 “通过探索这些可能性，报告强化了……

reflection.en: This report from Beyond Blue and CSIRO offers a forward-looking perspective on mental health in Australia, acknowledging both progress and persistent challenges. It highlights the importance of proactive choices in building a more resilient future for mental well-being. The Psalmist reminds us that Yahweh is the ultimate source of healing for those...
reflection.zh: 这份来自 Beyond Blue 和 CSIRO 的报告提供了对澳大利亚心理健康的未来展望，既肯定了进步，也承认了持续存在的挑战。它强调了在建设更具韧性的心理健康未来方面，积极选择的重要性。诗人提醒我们，雅伟是那些挣扎之人的最终医治之源，赐予希望和恢复。

title.en: Scientists find a bone-building switch that could fight osteoporosis
title.zh: 科学家发现骨骼生长开关，或可对抗骨质疏松症

summary.en: Researchers have identified an experimental compound, AP503, that significantly strengthens bones in mice by activating the GPR133 receptor, which promotes bone formation and reduces bone loss. This discovery holds potential for new osteoporosis treatments, especially as existing therapies have limitations and side...
summary.zh: 研究人员发现一种名为AP503的实验性化合物，通过激活GPR133受体，显著增强了小鼠的骨骼，该受体可促进骨骼形成并减缓骨骼流失。这一发现为骨质疏松症的新疗法带来了潜力，尤其考虑到现有疗法存在局限性和副作用。该化合物也显示出增强肌肉的潜力。

body.en:
Osteoporosis, a condition that weakens bones and increases the risk of fractures, affects millions of people and remains a major challenge for doctors seeking safe treatments that can be used over long periods. In Germany alone, about six million people are affected, most of them women.

Because existing therapies can have limitations and side effects, researchers are looking for new biological targets that could lead to more effective ways of preserving or rebuilding bone. Scientists at Leipzig University have now identified one such target in GPR133, a receptor that appears to play an important role in keeping bones strong.

GPR133 belongs to a group known as adhesion G protein-coupled receptors. These receptors sit on the surface of cells and help them respond to signals from their surroundings. Although this family of receptors is still not fully understood, the new findings suggest GPR133 is closely involved in the processes that build and maintain healthy bone.

"If this receptor is impaired by genetic changes, mice show signs of loss of bone density at an early age - similar to osteoporosis in humans. Using the substance AP503, which was only recently identified via a computer-assisted screen as a stimulator of GPR133, we were able to significantly increase bone strength in both healthy and osteoporotic mice," explains Professor Ines Liebscher, lead investigator of the study from the Rudolf Schönheimer Institute of Biochemistry at the Faculty of Medicine.

The results point to GPR133 as a potentially valuable target for future osteoporosis treatments. The researchers found that stimulating the receptor with AP503 increased bone strength not only in healthy mice, but also in mice with osteoporosis-like bone loss.

Inside bone tissue, GPR133 responds to physical forces and interactions between nearby bone cells. When the receptor is activated, it sets off signaling that changes the balance between the cells that build bone and those that break it down.

Bone-forming cells (osteoblasts) are responsible for producing new bone tissue. Bone-resorbing cells (osteoclasts), by contrast, remove old bone as part of the skeleton's normal cycle of renewal. Healthy bones depend on maintaining the right balance between these two processes.

Activation of GPR133 encourages the activity of osteoblasts while reducing the activity of osteoclasts. This shifts the balance toward stronger and more durable bone.

AP503 appears to imitate the natural process that activates GPR133. That raises the possibility that the compound could eventually be used to increase bone strength or help restore bone that has already been weakened. One potential application would be osteoporosis associated with menopause, when declining hormone levels can accelerate bone loss in...
body.zh: 骨质疏松症是一种削弱骨骼并增加骨折风险的疾病，影响数百万人，对于寻求可长期使用的安全治疗方法的医生来说仍然是一个重大挑战。仅在德国，就有约 600 万人受到影响，其中大多数是女性。 由于现有疗法可能存在局限性和副作用，研究人员正在寻找新的生物靶点，以找到更有效的保存或重建骨骼的方法。莱比锡大学的科学家现已在 GPR133 中发现了一个这样的靶标，GPR133 是一种似乎在保持骨骼强健方面发挥重要作用的受体。 GPR133 属于粘附 G 蛋白偶联受体组。这些受体位于细胞表面，帮助它们对周围环境的信号做出反应。尽管这个受体家族仍未被完全了解，但新发现表明 GPR133 密切参与构建和维持健康骨骼的过程。 “如果这种受体因基因变化而受损，小鼠就会在幼年时表现出骨密度下降的迹象，类似于人类的骨质疏松症。使用最近通过计算机辅助屏幕识别出的 AP503 物质作为 GPR133 的刺激剂，我们能够显着提高健康小鼠和骨质疏松小鼠的骨强度，”该研究的首席研究员、医学院 Rudolf Schönheimer 生物化学研究所的 Ines Liebscher 教授解释道。 结果表明 GPR133 是未来骨质疏松症治疗的潜在有价值的靶点。研究人员发现，用 AP503 刺激受体不仅可以增加健康小鼠的骨强度，还可以增加患有骨质疏松症样骨质流失的小鼠的骨强度。 在骨组织内部，GPR133 对物理力和附近骨细胞之间的相互作用做出反应。当受体被激活时，它会发出信号，改变构建骨骼的细胞和分解骨骼的细胞之间的平衡。 成骨细胞（成骨细胞）负责产生新的骨组织。相比之下，骨吸收细胞（破骨细胞）会去除旧骨，作为骨骼正常更新周期的一部分。健康的骨骼取决于保持这两个过程之间的适当平衡。 GPR133 的激活会促进成骨细胞的活性，同时降低破骨细胞的活性。这将使骨骼变得更坚固、更耐用。 AP503 似乎模仿激活 GPR133 的自然过程。这增加了这种化合物最终可用于增加骨骼强度或帮助恢复已经削弱的骨骼的可能性。一种潜在的应用是与更年期相关的骨质疏松症，激素水平下降会加速骨质流失......

reflection.en: The discovery of how to activate bone-building processes in mice offers a glimpse into the intricate wisdom embedded within creation. Like the ancient Job, we can learn profound truths by observing the natural world, recognizing the Creator's design in the very fabric of life. This scientific pursuit reflects a deep human desire to understand and heal,...
reflection.zh: 在小鼠身上发现激活骨骼生长过程的方法，让我们得以一窥造物中蕴含的精妙智慧。正如古时的约伯，我们可以通过观察自然界获得深刻的真理，认识到生命本质中造物主的创造设计。这项科学探索反映了人类对理解和治愈的深切渴望，也呼应了造物主自身的修复之工。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Ozempic and Wegovy linked to nearly 40% fewer asthma attacks
title.zh: 奥泽平与维格威与哮喘发作减少近40%相关

summary.en: A large real-world study found that semaglutide, the active ingredient in Ozempic and Wegovy, was associated with a nearly 40% reduction in asthma attacks and about a 20% decrease in COPD flare-ups. Researchers suggest that GLP-1 drugs might offer respiratory benefits.
summary.zh: 一项大型真实世界研究发现，奥泽平（Ozempic）和维格威（Wegovy）中的活性成分司美格鲁肽（semaglutide）与哮喘发作减少近40%以及慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）急性加重减少约20%相关。研究人员推测，GLP-1类药物可能具有呼吸益处。

body.en:
Semaglutide, a medication widely used for type 2 diabetes and weight loss, may also provide an unexpected benefit for people with asthma. New research presented at the European Respiratory Society (ERS) Congress in Barcelona, Spain, found that semaglutide use was associated with a reduction in asthma attacks of nearly 40%.

The study was led by Professor Chloe Bloom, Clinical Associate Professor in Respiratory Epidemiology at the National Heart & Lung Institute, Imperial College London, UK, and presented by Dr. Bohee Lee.

Dr. Bloom said: "GLP-1 receptor agonists are widely used to treat type 2 diabetes and obesity. Previous research suggests that they may have anti-inflammatory effects and may improve lung-related outcomes. However, asthma and COPD outcomes have not been included as outcomes in GLP-1 drug trials.

"We wanted to use real-world health records to investigate whether people with asthma or COPD who started GLP-1 receptor agonists had fewer acute respiratory attacks."

To investigate that question, the researchers analyzed electronic medical records from the UK. They carried out four parallel studies, each involving between 20,000 and 22,000 people who had started treatment with either a GLP-1 medication or a different type of diabetes drug known as a sulfonylurea.

The results suggested that people with airway diseases such as asthma and COPD who received GLP-1 therapies experienced fewer asthma attacks and COPD flare-ups than comparable patients who were prescribed other diabetes medications.

Among the GLP-1 drugs examined, semaglutide appeared to stand out, particularly for people with asthma.

Bloom explains: "The effect was strongest with semaglutide, especially in people with asthma, where use of semaglutide appears to be associated with nearly a 40% reduction in asthma attacks. Semaglutide also led to a 20% reduction in COPD flare-ups."

The findings suggest that people who already qualify for GLP-1 receptor agonists because they have obesity or type 2 diabetes could potentially receive an additional benefit for their respiratory health.

However, Bloom emphasized that the results are not enough to recommend these medications specifically as treatments for asthma or COPD.

She explains: "The findings from this study are encouraging, but they should not change treatment decisions on their own. People with asthma or COPD should not start GLP-1 receptor agonists specifically for their lung condition outside current prescribing guidance. While the findings suggest that some people taking GLP-1 receptor agonists may experience fewer respiratory attacks, this needs confirmation in clinical trials."

Dr. Alexander Mathioudakis, Chair of the European Respiratory Society's Group on Airway Pharmacology and Treatment and Senior Lecturer in...
body.zh: 索马鲁肽是一种广泛用于治疗 2 型糖尿病和减肥的药物，也可能为哮喘患者带来意想不到的益处。在西班牙巴塞罗那举行的欧洲呼吸学会 (ERS) 大会上发表的新研究发现，使用索马鲁肽可使哮喘发作减少近 40%。 该研究由英国伦敦帝国理工学院国家心肺研究所呼吸流行病学临床副教授 Chloe Bloom 教授领导，并由 Bohee Lee 博士介绍。 Bloom博士说：“GLP-1受体激动剂广泛用于治疗2型糖尿病和肥胖症。之前的研究表明它们可能具有抗炎作用，并可能改善肺部相关的结果。然而，哮喘和慢性阻塞性肺病的结果尚未被纳入GLP-1药物试验的结果中。 “我们希望利用真实世界的健康记录来调查患有哮喘或慢性阻塞性肺病的患者在开始使用 GLP-1 受体激动剂后是否较少发生急性呼吸道疾病。” 为了调查这个问题，研究人员分析了来自英国的电子病历。他们进行了四项平行研究，每项研究涉及 20,000 至 22,000 名已开始使用 GLP-1 药物或另一种称为磺酰脲类的糖尿病药物进行治疗的人。 结果表明，患有哮喘和慢性阻塞性肺病等气道疾病的患者接受 GLP-1 治疗后，与服用其他糖尿病药物的患者相比，哮喘发作和慢性阻塞性肺病发作的次数更少。 在检查的 GLP-1 药物中，索马鲁肽似乎脱颖而出，特别是对于哮喘患者。 Bloom 解释说：“索马鲁肽的效果最强，尤其是对于哮喘患者，使用索马鲁肽似乎可以使哮喘发作减少近 40%。索马鲁肽还使 COPD 发作减少了 20%。” 研究结果表明，因患有肥胖症或 2 型糖尿病而已经有资格使用 GLP-1 受体激动剂的人可能会获得对呼吸系统健康的额外益处。 然而，布鲁姆强调，这些结果不足以推荐这些药物专门用于治疗哮喘或慢性阻塞性肺病。 她解释说：“这项研究的结果令人鼓舞，但它们不应该自行改变治疗决定。哮喘或慢性阻塞性肺病患者不应在当前处方指南之外开始专门针对其肺部状况使用 GLP-1 受体激动剂。虽然研究结果表明，一些服用 GLP-1 受体激动剂的人可能会减少呼吸道疾病的发作，但这需要临床试验的证实。” Alexander Mathioudakis 博士，欧洲呼吸学会气道药理学和治疗小组主席，高级讲师...

reflection.en: It is a profound comfort when scientific inquiry uncovers unexpected avenues for healing. This research, linking GLP-1 drugs to fewer asthma attacks, echoes the ancient wisdom of bringing our concerns for the sick to God. May we continue to seek and share knowledge that alleviates suffering, trusting in divine wisdom that guides discovery.
reflection.zh: 当科学探究揭示出意想不到的疗愈途径时，这是一种深刻的安慰。这项研究将GLP-1类药物与哮喘发作减少联系起来，呼应了将病人忧虑带到雅伟面前的古老智慧。愿我们继续寻求和分享减轻痛苦的知识，信靠那引导发现的神圣智慧。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Have we found alien life? Hundreds of scientists weigh in
title.zh: 我们找到外星生命了吗？数百名科学家发表看法

summary.en: Two major announcements in 2025 regarding potential alien life generated significant excitement. However, a survey revealed that most astrobiologists remain unconvinced, with only 6.6% believing that possible biological molecules on K2-18b likely represent extraterrestrial life, and 15.1% holding the same view for...
summary.zh: 2025年关于潜在外星生命的两项重大公告引起了巨大轰动。然而，一项调查显示，大多数天体生物学家仍持怀疑态度，只有6.6%的人认为K2-18b上可能的生物分子很可能代表外星生命，另有15.1%的人对火星上的发现持相同看法。

body.en:
It may seem like we are on the verge of discovering alien life. In 2025, a press release stated that we have the “ strongest hints yet ” of extraterrestrial life on the exoplanet K2-18b. And when talking about a collected sample from a rock named “Cheyava Falls” on Mars, NASA Administrator Sean Duffy said this was the “ closest we have ever come ” to discovering life on the red planet.

Such moments capture the imagination. But they also raise an important question: what do the majority of scientists actually think?

Surprisingly, we usually don’t know. When a scientific controversy or breakthrough dominates headlines, press officers and journalists often quote a handful of experts. These views may be insightful, but they rarely tell us what the wider scientific community thinks. And yet public discussions frequently rely on phrases such as “the science says” or “scientists believe”, as if there were a clear and measurable answer.

In reality, systematic evidence about scientific opinion is often missing. My colleagues and I recently tried to change that in the domain of astrobiology. Shortly after the two major announcements of possible extraterrestrial life in 2025, we surveyed astrobiologists to understand how expert judgment was distributed across the field.

The first case concerned the exoplanet K2-18b. In April 2025, researchers reported possible traces of molecules called dimethyl sulfide and/or dimethyl disulfide. On Earth, these are associated with biological activity. Media coverage was extensive, with many reports framing the finding as an extraordinary advance in the search for alien life.

The second case came in September, when NASA announced that Cheyava Falls appeared to preserve a potential biosignature – so-called “leopard spots” which are mineral rings that on Earth are often formed by microbial activity. Again, headlines, and NASA officials themselves, suggested something momentous.

We surveyed hundreds of astrobiologists from across the global research community, within days of each announcement. We asked a simple question: did scientists think extraterrestrial life had probably been found?

The results revealed a rather cautious picture. For K2-18b, only 6.6% of surveyed astrobiologists agreed that scientists had probably found extraterrestrial life. Nearly two-thirds disagreed, while 28.0% remained neutral. For the Mars case, confidence was higher but still cautious: 15.1% agreed, disagreement fell to 44.6% and neutrality rose to 40.3%.

Looking only at agreement and disagreement, however, misses an important part of the story. The proportion of astrobiologists who strongly disagreed fell dramatically, from 35.1% in the K2-18b case to just...
body.zh: 看起来我们正处于发现外星生命的边缘。 2025 年，一份新闻稿称，我们在系外行星 K2-18b 上获得了“迄今为止最强烈​​的迹象”，表明存在外星生命。在谈到从火星上名为“Cheyava Falls”的岩石收集的样本时，美国宇航局局长肖恩·达菲表示，这是我们“最接近”在这颗红色星球上发现生命的一次。 这样的时刻激发了人们的想象力。但他们也提出了一个重要的问题：大多数科学家实际上是怎么想的？ 令人惊讶的是，我们通常不知道。当科学争议或突破占据头条新闻时，新闻官员和记者经常引用少数专家的观点。这些观点可能很有洞察力，但它们很少告诉我们更广泛的科学界的想法。然而，公众讨论经常依赖“科学说”或“科学家相信”等短语，仿佛有一个明确且可衡量的答案。 事实上，关于科学观点的系统证据常常缺失。我和我的同事最近试图在天体生物学领域改变这一现状。在两次重大宣布 2025 年可能存在外星生命之后不久，我们对天体生物学家进行了调查，以了解专家判断在整个领域的分布情况。 第一个案例涉及系外行星 K2-18b。 2025 年 4 月，研究人员报告了可能存在被称为二甲基硫醚和/或二甲基二硫醚的分子痕迹。在地球上，这些与生物活动有关。媒体报道广泛，许多报道将这一发现视为寻找外星生命的非凡进展。 第二个案例发生在九月，当时美国宇航局宣布切亚瓦瀑布似乎保留了潜在的生物特征——所谓的“豹斑”，这是地球上通常由微生物活动形成的矿物环。头条新闻和美国宇航局官员本人再次暗示了一些重大事件。 在每次发布后的几天内，我们对来自全球研究界的数百名天体生物学家进行了调查。我们问了一个简单的问题：科学家认为可能已经发现了外星生命吗？ 结果显示出相当谨慎的情况。对于 K2-18b，只有 6.6% 的受访天体生物学家认为科学家可能已经发现了外星生命。近三分之二的人不同意，28.0% 的人保持中立。对于火星案例，信心较高，但仍持谨慎态度：同意的比例为 15.1%，不同意的比例下降至 44.6%，中立的比例上升至 40.3%。 然而，只看同意和分歧，就忽略了故事的一个重要部分。强烈反对的天体生物学家比例急剧下降，从 K2-18b 案例中的 35.1% 降至仅......

reflection.en: The pursuit of life beyond Earth is a profound human endeavor, pushing the boundaries of our knowledge. Yet, as these scientists demonstrate, true discovery requires careful observation and a humble acknowledgment of what remains unknown. The natural world, in all its complexity, is a testament to wisdom, inviting us to learn from its intricate design.
reflection.zh: 对地球以外生命的探索是一项深刻的人类事业，它不断拓展我们知识的边界。然而，正如这些科学家所展示的，真正的发现需要仔细的观察，并谦虚地承认那些仍然未知的事物。大自然以其复杂性，本身就是智慧的明证，邀请我们从其精妙的设计中学习。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Hurrah, lie-ins may be good for us – if only I can convince my five-year-old daughter | Arwa Mahdawi
title.zh: 好消息，赖床可能对我们有好处——如果我能说服我五岁的女儿的话

summary.en: The author, Arwa Mahdawi, argues for the benefits of lie-ins, contrasting this with the early-rising habits of CEOs. She cites a study presented at the European Society of Cardiology that found weekend lie-ins may protect against high blood pressure, encouraging people not to feel guilty about sleeping longer.
summary.zh: 作者 Arwa Mahdawi 提倡赖床的好处，并将其与首席执行官们早起的习惯进行对比。她引用了在欧洲心脏病学会年会上公布的一项研究，该研究发现周末赖床可能有助于预防高血压，并鼓励人们不要因为多睡一会儿而感到内疚。

body.en: CEOs may like to get up at the crack of dawn and go for a run, but I prefer optimising my life with lie-ins, trashy films, swearing and coffee This evening I’m going to tuck my five-year-old into bed and read her a chapter from one of her princess books, followed by a summary of research recently presented at the annual congress of the European Society of Cardiology. Once upon a time, I’ll tell her, there was a scientist called Dr Nawon Lee who authored a study that found having a weekend lie-in may be very good for you and can protect against high blood pressure. Our accomplished protagonist Dr Lee said: “People should not feel lazy or guilty for sleeping a little longer on the weekend.” And the moral of this story, dear child, is that you should try not to wake your mothers up at 6am every day. Unfortunately, I’m not sure that all the peer-reviewed science in the world will convince my early riser to have a weekend lie-in. Still, as a big fan of sleep and someone who has never once felt guilty for hitting the snooze button, I have to say I feel vindicated by this new study. CEOs can get up at 4am and run 10 miles before eating five foraged mushrooms if they want to, but I’m going to protect my heart health by sleeping in, any opportunity I can get, thank you very much. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 首席执行官们可能喜欢在黎明时分起床去跑步，但我更喜欢通过睡懒觉、垃圾电影、脏话和咖啡来优化我的生活。今晚，我要让我五岁的孩子上床睡觉，给她读一本公主书中的一章，然后是最近在欧洲心脏病学会年会上提出的研究摘要。我会告诉她，曾几何时，有一位名叫 Nawon Lee 博士的科学家撰写了一项研究，发现周末睡个懒觉可能对你非常有好处，并且可以预防高血压。我们的主角李博士说：“人们不应该因为周末多睡一点而感到懒惰或内疚。”亲爱的孩子，这个故事的寓意是，你应该尽量不要每天早上 6 点叫醒你的母亲。不幸的是，我不确定世界上所有经过同行评审的科学都能说服我早起的人周末睡个懒觉。尽管如此，作为睡眠的忠实粉丝和从未因按下小睡按钮而感到内疚的人，我不得不说，这项新研究证明了我的正确性。如果 CEO 愿意的话，他们可以凌晨 4 点起床，跑 10 英里，然后吃 5 个采摘的蘑菇，但我会通过睡懒觉来保护我的心脏健康，只要有机会，我都会这样做，非常感谢。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a culture that often glorifies constant activity and early rising, this news reminds us that rest is not laziness but a vital part of well-being. Just as the study suggests lie-ins can be beneficial, Jesus invites us to find true rest in Him, offering solace from the pressures of life.
reflection.zh: 在一个常常推崇持续活动和早起的文化中，这则新闻提醒我们，休息并非懒惰，而是身心健康的重要组成部分。正如研究表明赖床有益，耶稣也邀请我们在祂里面找到真正的安息，从生活的压力中获得慰藉。

verse.textEn: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
verse.textZh: 凡劳苦担重担的人，可以到我这里来，我就使你们得安息。

title.en: Interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS is bursting with methanol
title.zh: 星际彗星3I/ATLAS富含甲醇

summary.en: Interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS has been found to contain exceptionally high levels of methanol, suggesting it formed under conditions different from those in our solar system. Observations indicate that tiny icy grains around the comet are releasing methanol.
summary.zh: 星际彗星3I/ATLAS被发现含有异常高含量的甲醇，这表明它是在与我们太阳系中大多数彗星形成条件截然不同的环境下形成的。观测表明，彗星周围的微小冰粒正在释放甲醇。

body.en:
Comet 3I/ATLAS is continuing to surprise astronomers. New observations from the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA), of which the U.S. National Science Foundation National Radio Astronomy Observatory (NSF NRAO) is a partner, show that the interstellar visitor contains an unusually large amount of methanol. In fact, its methanol abundance exceeds that seen in almost all known comets from our own solar system.

"Observing 3I/ATLAS is like taking a fingerprint from another solar system," shares Nathan Roth, lead author on this research, and a professor with American University, "The details reveal what it's made of, and it's bursting with methanol in a way we just don't usually see in comets in our own solar system."

The research team used ALMA's Atacama Compact Array in Chile to observe 3I/ATLAS on several dates in late 2025 as it moved closer to the Sun. As sunlight heated the comet's icy surface, gas and dust escaped and created a bright cloud (or coma) around its core.

By studying the molecules in this coma, astronomers could identify the chemical makeup of material carried by the comet. Because 3I/ATLAS originated outside our solar system, those measurements provide a rare opportunity to investigate how small icy bodies may form in another planetary system without traveling beyond our own.

The scientists concentrated on the faint submillimeter signatures of two molecules: methanol (CH 3 OH), a type of alcohol, and hydrogen cyanide (HCN), a nitrogen-bearing organic molecule commonly seen in comets.

ALMA revealed that 3I/ATLAS contains an unusually high amount of methanol relative to hydrogen cyanide. On two observation dates, researchers measured methanol-to-HCN ratios of roughly 70 and 120. Those values place 3I/ATLAS among the most methanol-rich solar system comets ever studied.

The measurements suggest that the ice inside 3I/ATLAS formed under, or was later exposed to, conditions very different from those experienced by most comets in our solar system.

Earlier observations with the James Webb Space Telescope found that 3I/ATLAS had a coma dominated by carbon dioxide while it was still far from the Sun. The new ALMA measurements now add abundant methanol to the growing list of unusual features in the comet's chemical makeup.

ALMA's high resolution for imaging also allowed astronomers to track how different molecules are released and travel away from the comet. The observations revealed a striking contrast between methanol and hydrogen cyanide.

Hydrogen cyanide appears to originate mostly from the comet's central body, or nucleus. That behavior is common among comets in our solar system. Methanol, however, appears to come from both the nucleus AND from ice particles floating within the coma.

reflection.en: The universe is a vast library, and each celestial body, like the interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS, holds unique chapters. Studying its composition, particularly the abundance of methanol, offers a glimpse into the diverse processes of creation beyond our own solar system. This cosmic exploration reminds us that Yahweh's wisdom is revealed in the intricate...
reflection.zh: 宇宙是一座浩瀚的图书馆，而每一个天体，如星际彗星3I/ATLAS，都蕴藏着独特的篇章。研究它的构成，特别是甲醇的丰度，让我们得以一窥我们太阳系之外，那形形色色的创造过程。这场宇宙探索提醒我们，雅伟的智慧显明在他一切所造的精妙细节之中。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Drinking very hot drinks could triple risk of oesophageal cancer, study finds
title.zh: 饮用过热饮料或使食道癌风险加倍

summary.en: A new study suggests that consuming very hot beverages, such as tea and coffee, can triple the risk of developing esophageal cancer. Researchers advise allowing hot drinks to cool to a comfortable temperature before consumption to mitigate this risk.
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，饮用过热的饮料，如茶和咖啡，会将患食道癌的风险增加两倍。研究人员建议，在饮用前将热饮放凉至舒适的温度，以降低患病风险。

body.en: Research finds temperature and amount of hot drinks consumed heightens possibility of developing disease Drinking very hot tea and coffee triples the risk of developing cancer of the gullet, the world’s largest study of the link between them has found. The findings show that people should let very hot cups of tea and coffee cool down until they are comfortable to drink, in order to reduce their risk of the disease, cancer experts said. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究发现，喝热饮的温度和量会增加患疾病的可能性 世界上最大的关于两者之间联系的研究发现，喝很热的茶和咖啡会使患食道癌的风险增加三倍。癌症专家表示，研究结果表明，人们应该让很热的茶和咖啡冷却下来，直到可以舒服地饮用为止，以降低患这种疾病的风险。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This study highlights a tangible risk associated with a common daily habit. It reminds us that even seemingly small choices can have significant health consequences. As we navigate our routines, let us be mindful of practices that may harm us and seek wisdom in caring for the bodies Yahweh has given us.
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了一种与日常习惯相关的实际风险。它提醒我们，即使是看似微小的选择也可能对健康产生重大影响。在我们日常生活中，让我们留意那些可能伤害我们的行为，并在照顾雅伟所赐予的身体方面寻求智慧。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Beavers 'could boost wildlife and tackle drought'
title.zh: 海狸“可促进野生动植物并应对干旱”

summary.en: Gloucestershire Wildlife Trust is looking for suitable areas to reintroduce the animals, which supporters say could help landscapes become more resilient to drought and climate change.
summary.zh: 格洛斯特郡野生动物信托基金正在寻找适合重新引入海狸的区域，支持者认为这有助于使景观更能抵御干旱和气候变化。

body.en:
Supporters of a plan to reintroduce beavers to a county say they could help landscapes become more resilient to drought and climate change.

Gloucestershire Wildlife Trust and Forestry England are surveying different parts of the county to assess their suitability for a new reintroduction programme.

"Beavers are a keystone species" said Emily Bowen of the Beaver Trust. "They are ecosystem engineers, which means that they can have a massive impact on the landscape around them."

The Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs (Defra), which would have to approve the measure, said it could make a "huge difference to nature recovery".

"By changing the land to suit their needs, they can change it in such a way that boosts biodiversity and increases resilience in terms of climate change," Bowen added.

As semi-aquatic mammals, beavers are known for building dams that create ponds and wetlands.

Even small streams can feed a substantial wetland habitat that will then support an abundant array of biodiversity.

Beavers are a native species, but have not been a regular sight in the west of England for around 400 years, after hunting for food and medical ingredients forced their numbers to dramatically decline.

A Defra spokesperson said: "Reintroducing beavers has the potential to make a huge difference to nature recovery, and we are proud to champion this work.

"We will continue to support our partners and ensure that the return of beavers benefits both wildlife and communities."

Beavers have already been living at Greathough Brook in the Forest of Dean since 2018 and regular surveys have revealed a dramatic increase in biodiversity.

"I've seen stoats, I've seen weasels, I've even seen pine martens," said Kate Wollen, from Forestry England.

"The beavers have created this amazing habitat that has brought in all the insects that are at the bottom of the food chain and then it brings in all the other animals that then feed on them, it's just a whole wonderful network of habitats."

A new re-introduction programme in the Severn Vale area would require a government licence.

Studies are being carried out to find suitable locations and a consultation is underway with landowners and users who might be affected by the change in the landscape.

"We have to make sure that we are working really closely with people who live, work and manage the areas that we're thinking about putting beavers," said Mega Adamou, of Gloucestershire Wildlife Trust.

"We'll be seeing a little bit more resilience to drought in those areas where the beavers might end up living."

"It's been really interesting to see how the general public have taken to beavers and getting people thinking about seeing them back in our countryside."

body.zh: 将海狸重新引入一个县的计划的支持者表示，这可以帮助当地的景观变得更能抵御干旱和气候变化。 格洛斯特郡野生动物信托基金和英格兰林业局正在对该县的不同地区进行调查，以评估其是否适合新的重新引入计划。 “海狸是一个关键物种”，海狸信托基金的艾米丽·鲍文 (Emily Bowen) 说道。 “他们是生态系统工程师，这意味着他们可以对周围的景观产生巨大影响。” 环境、食品和农村事务部（Defra）必须批准这项措施，并表示这可能对“自然恢复产生巨大影响”。 鲍文补充道：“通过改变土地以满足他们的需求，他们可以以促进生物多样性和增强气候变化抵御能力的方式改变土地。” 作为半水生哺乳动物，海狸以建造水坝、形成池塘和湿地而闻名。 即使是小溪流也可以滋养大量的湿地栖息地，从而支持丰富的生物多样性。 海狸是本地物种，但在大约 400 年来，在英格兰西部不再常见，因为对食物和药用成分的捕猎迫使它们的数量急剧下降。 Defra 发言人表示：“重新引入海狸有可能对自然恢复产生巨大影响，我们很自豪能够支持这项工作。 “我们将继续支持我们的合作伙伴，并确保海狸的回归使野生动物和社区受益。” 自 2018 年以来，海狸就生活在迪恩森林的格雷特霍夫溪，定期调查显示生物多样性急剧增加。 “我见过白鼬，见过黄鼠狼，甚至见过松貂，”英国林业局的凯特·沃伦说。 “海狸创造了这个令人惊叹的栖息地，它引入了食物链底部的所有昆虫，然后又引入了以它们为食的所有其他动物，这是一个美妙的栖息地网络。” 塞文谷地区新的重新引入计划需要政府许可。 目前正在开展研究以寻找合适的地点，并正在与可能受到景观变化影响的土地所有者和使用者进行协商。 格洛斯特郡野生动物信托基金会的梅加·阿达穆 (Mega Adamou) 表示：“我们必须确保我们与生活、工作和管理我们考虑放海狸的地区的人们真正密切合作。” “我们将看到海狸最终生活的地区对干旱的恢复能力更强。” “看到公众如何喜欢海狸并让人们考虑回到我们的乡村看到它们真的很有趣。” 已经有三个许可版本...

reflection.en: The reintroduction of beavers in Gloucestershire is a hopeful sign of ecological restoration. These 'ecosystem engineers' have the potential to heal damaged landscapes, reminding us of the inherent goodness and resilience of Yahweh's creation when given a chance to flourish.
reflection.zh: 在格洛斯特郡重新引入海狸是生态恢复的希望迹象。这些“生态系统工程师”有潜力治愈受损的景观，提醒我们当雅伟的创造物有机会繁荣时，其固有的良善和韧性。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Douglas Head designated a Conservation Area
title.zh: 道格拉斯角被指定为保护区

summary.en: Douglas Head has been formally designated a Conservation Area by the Manx government, recognizing its significant historical, architectural, and cultural importance. This designation, supported by 92% of the public in a recent consultation, restricts property alterations without planning permission to preserve the...
summary.zh: 道格拉斯角已被马恩岛政府正式指定为保护区，以表彰其重要的历史、建筑和文化意义。这项指定在最近的公众咨询中获得了92%的支持，限制了未经规划许可对房产进行的改动，以保护该地区的特色。

body.en:
Douglas Head has been formally designated a Conservation Area by the Manx government.

Douglas City Council said it "welcomed" the move, recognising the headland's "significant historical, architectural and cultural importance".

It follows years of campaigning by local historians and two public consultations, the most recent of which found 92% support for the move.

While the designation does not prevent all development on the headland, it does restrict the kind of changes owners to property within the boundary can make without first obtaining planning permission.

Applications consider whether any alterations would preserve or enhance the area's character.

The Isle of Man's Area Plan says applications within the boundary "will generally not be supported."

Douglas Head already has eight registered buildings, more than almost anywhere else on the island outside of central Douglas.

They include the Great Union Camera Obscura (1892), Douglas Lighthouse, the Harbour Swing Bridge Tower and its original 1895 machinery, and Harold Tower.

Read more stories from the Isle of Man on the BBC, watch BBC North West Tonight on BBC iPlayer and follow BBC Isle of Man on Facebook , external and X , external .
body.zh: 道格拉斯角已被马恩岛政府正式指定为保护区。 道格拉斯市议会表示“欢迎”此举，并认识到该岬角“具有重要的历史、建筑和文化重要性”。 此前，当地历史学家进行了多年的竞选活动并进行了两次公众咨询，最近一次咨询的支持率高达 92%。 虽然这一指定并不妨碍岬角上的所有开发，但它确实限制了边界内财产所有者在未事先获得规划许可的情况下可以进行的变更。 申请会考虑任何改变是否会保留或增强该地区的特色。 马恩岛地区规划表示，边界内的申请“通常不会得到支持”。 道格拉斯角已经拥有八座注册建筑，几乎比道格拉斯中部以外的岛上其他任何地方都多。 其中包括大联合暗箱 (1892 年)、道格拉斯灯塔、海港平转桥塔及其 1895 年原始机械装置以及哈罗德塔。 在 BBC 上阅读更多来自马恩岛的故事，在 BBC iPlayer 上观看 BBC 西北今晚节目，并在 Facebook、external 和 X, external 上关注 BBC Isle of Man。

reflection.en: The formal designation of Douglas Head as a Conservation Area highlights a community's decision to protect a place of historical and cultural value. It echoes the ancient understanding that all the earth, with its unique landscapes and heritage, ultimately belongs to its Creator, calling for careful stewardship and preservation.
reflection.zh: 道格拉斯角被正式指定为保护区，这体现了社区保护一个具有历史和文化价值之地的决定。它呼应了古老的认识，即全地及其独特的景观和遗产，最终都属于其创造者，这呼吁我们进行审慎的管理和保护。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: 'Adrenaline got us through New Forest wildfire'
title.zh: 新森林野火：消防员称“肾上腺素让我们挺过难关”

summary.en: Firefighters described the New Forest wildfire, which destroyed over 100 hectares of ancient trees and heathland, as 'apocalyptic.' They credited adrenaline and community spirit for helping them manage the blaze that started from a van fire on the A31.
summary.zh: 消防员形容新森林的野火“如同末日”，摧毁了超过100公顷的古树和石楠地。他们将扑灭这场始于A31公路一辆货车起火的火灾归功于肾上腺素和社区精神。

body.en:
"It was almost apocalyptic," recalls retained firefighter Matt O'Hare, as he describes the scene that greeted him at the devastating wildfire in the New Forest.

Fire spread from a blazing van on the A31 on 9 August, destroying ancient oak and beech trees, rare heathland and wildlife across an area of more than 100 hectares .

"As we went through the New Forest, we could see the huge smoke plume and we thought, 'This is big'," he said.

"It was really weird. You had all the cars that had been stopped on the A31 parked up either side, people in the road.

As the wind rapidly swept the flames across the forest, O'Hare and his colleagues went towards the fire.

"At that time, we were going, 'How on earth are we going to stop this?' But we were told where to go by senior officers and you just sort of deal with the area that you are in as best as you can," he said.

A major incident was declared, and fire crews from neighbouring counties and beyond helped tackle the fire.

About 130 firefighters were on the scene of the fire at the peak of the incident, working in heatwave conditions.

Like many retained firefighters, O'Hare has another job that he needed to keep up alongside his firefighting duties.

"I was doing 10-to-12-hour shifts on the A31, then coming home early in the morning and working from 08:00 to 18:00 at my manufacturing job.

Watch manager at Fordingbridge Fire Station Shaun Lincoln, 59, said it was the largest fire he had been to in 21 years as a firefighter.

"It was off the scale, very, very tiring. I think adrenaline keeps you going and community spirit," he said.

"We live in the New Forest, it's quite personal to us, we wanted to get there and do our bit."

Lincoln said all the crew had been touched by the gratitude shown by local people, who clapped as they returned from fighting the fire.

"There were hampers, cakes and hydration drinks. It was really, really nice, a little bit of fuel for the guys coming back from a long shift," he said.

"I am really, really proud. Everyone worked their socks off, day in, day out. The guys just didn't stop from day one to the end."

You can follow BBC Hampshire & Isle of Wight on Facebook , external , X (Twitter) , external , or Instagram , external .
body.zh: “这几乎是世界末日，”留任的消防员马特·奥黑尔回忆道，他描述了新森林毁灭性野火中迎接他的场景。 8 月 9 日，A31 公路上一辆着火的面包车起火，烧毁了古老的橡树和山毛榉树、稀有的石南地和野生动物，面积超过 100 公顷。 “当我们穿过新森林时，我们可以看到巨大的烟雾，我们想，‘这很大’，”他说。 “这真的很奇怪。A31 公路上停的所有汽车都停在两边，路上还有人。 当风迅速席卷森林时，奥黑尔和他的同事们走向了火场。 “当时，我们想，‘我们到底要如何阻止这一切？’但高级官员告诉我们该去哪里，而你只是尽可能地处理你所在的区域，”他说。 宣布发生重大事故，来自邻近县及其他地区的消防人员帮助扑灭火灾。 事故最严重时，约有 130 名消防员在火灾现场，在热浪条件下工作。 与许多留任的消防员一样，奥黑尔在履行消防职责的同时还需要从事另一项工作。 “我在 A31 上进行 10 到 12 小时的轮班，然后一大早就回家，从 08:00 到 18:00 从事我的制造工作。 59 岁的福丁布里奇消防局值班经理肖恩·林肯 (Shaun Lincoln) 表示，这是他作为消防员 21 年来经历过的最大火灾。 “这超出了规模，非常非常累。我认为肾上腺素可以让你保持前进和社区精神，”他说。 “我们住在新森林，这对我们来说非常个人化，我们想到达那里并尽自己的一份力量。” 林肯说，所有船员都被当地人表现出的感激之情所感动，当他们救火归来时，当地人鼓掌。 “有礼篮、蛋糕和补水饮料。这真的非常非常好，为那些从长时间轮班回来的人提供了一点燃料，”他说。 “我真的非常非常自豪。每个人都日复一日地努力工作。这些人从第一天到最后都没有停下来。” 您可以在 Facebook、external、X (Twitter)、external 或 Instagram、external 上关注 BBC Hampshire & Isle of Wight。

reflection.en: The wildfire in the New Forest sounds like an overwhelming and terrifying event, pushing the firefighters to their limits. Yet, even in the face of such destruction, they found the strength to continue. This reminds us that even when we feel utterly spent, Yahweh promises to renew our strength, allowing us to soar like eagles, ready to face whatever...
reflection.zh: 新森林的野火听起来是一场压倒性的、可怕的事件，将消防员推向了极限。然而，即使面对如此的破坏，他们也找到了继续前进的力量。这提醒我们，即使在我们感到筋疲力尽时，雅伟也应许要使我们重新得力，使我们能如鹰展翅，准备好面对前方的任何挑战。

verse.textEn: Those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary.
verse.textZh: 但那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。他们必如鹰展翅上腾。

title.en: Backshall backs calls for natural history GCSE
title.zh: Backshall 支持将自然历史列为 GCSE 课程的呼吁

summary.en: Naturalist Steve Backshall and Sir Tim Smit are advocating for nature education to be central to school curricula, proposing a new GCSE in natural history. This initiative comes amid survey data indicating that 55% of children have never climbed a tree, highlighting a disconnect from the natural world.
summary.zh: 博物学家史蒂夫·巴克肖尔和蒂姆·史密斯爵士呼吁将自然教育置于学校课程的核心，并提议开设新的自然历史 GCSE 课程。此前的一项调查显示，55% 的儿童从未爬过树，这凸显了与自然世界的脱节。

body.en:
Naturalist Steve Backshall and Lost Gardens of Heligan co-founder Sir Tim Smit have called for more "greenlightenment" to put nature education at the heart of school curriculums.

It comes as the government has been consulting on a new natural history GCSE , which Sir Tim said was a "seismic moment for British education", adding "a deep understanding of the natural world is fundamental to humanity's future".

Backshall, who hosted the Wild Heligan experience to excite young people about wildlife, said: "I see every day how nature revitalises, restores and fills people with joy."

A survey by Heligan of 1,004 parent and child groups across England found 55% of children had never climbed a tree.

Backshall said: "We can get so much from the wild world, but now more than ever the wild world needs us.

"Young people who are engaged with nature will be happier, healthier and more likely to take on our planet's problems."

Sir Tim said: "It is our responsibility to equip the next generation with the tools to protect nature so it doesn't become history."

He added children had not lost their interest in nature but had lost opportunities to experience it.

The survey found "ordinary contact with nature" was unfamiliar to many children and 61% of children had never collected a conker or camped in a tent.

The research also found 34% of children they asked said they would definitely choose the proposed natural history GCSE if their school offered it, with another 41% saying they probably would.

The government said, if brought in, the GCSE would "ensure that children are equipped with the highly sought after skills for the workforce of a changing world" and could help reduce the number of number of young people not in education, employment or training.

Follow BBC Cornwall on X , external , Facebook , external and Instagram , external . Send your story ideas to spotlight@bbc.co.uk , external .
body.zh: 博物学家史蒂夫·巴克歇尔和黑里根失落花园联合创始人蒂姆·斯密特爵士呼吁更多的“绿灯”，将自然教育置于学校课程的核心。 与此同时，政府正在就新的自然历史GCSE进行咨询，蒂姆爵士表示这是“英国教育的一个地震时刻”，并补充说“对自然世界的深刻理解是人类未来的基础”。 巴克歇尔主持了野生黑里根体验活动，旨在激发年轻人对野生动物的兴趣，他说：“我每天都看到大自然如何焕发活力、恢复活力，让人们充满欢乐。” Heligan 对英格兰 1,004 个家长和儿童团体进行的一项调查发现，55% 的儿童从未爬过树。 巴克歇尔说：“我们可以从野生世界得到很多东西，但现在野生世界比以往任何时候都更需要我们。 “接触大自然的年轻人会更快乐、更健康，更有可能承担我们星球的问题。” 蒂姆爵士说：“我们有责任为下一代配备保护自然的工具，以免它成为历史。” 他补充说，孩子们并没有失去对大自然的兴趣，但失去了体验大自然的机会。 调查发现，“与大自然的普通接触”对许多孩子来说并不熟悉，61%的孩子从未收集过七叶树果树或在帐篷里露营过。 研究还发现，34% 的受访儿童表示，如果学校提供自然历史 GCSE 课程，他们肯定会选择，另有 41% 的儿童表示可能会选择。 政府表示，如果引入GCSE，将“确保儿童具备在不断变化的世界中劳动力市场备受追捧的技能”，并有助于减少未接受教育、就业或培训的年轻人数量。 在 X, external、Facebook, external 和 Instagram, external 上关注 BBC Cornwall。将您的故事创意发送至外部聚光灯@bbc.co.uk。

reflection.en: The call for a natural history GCSE reflects a deep concern for how we are 'forming the young.' When a significant majority of children haven't experienced something as fundamental as climbing a tree, it signals a need to intentionally re-engage them with the natural world. This education is not just about facts, but about fostering a sense of wonder and...
reflection.zh: 呼吁开设自然历史 GCSE 课程，反映了对我们如何“塑造年轻人”的深切担忧。当绝大多数儿童从未体验过爬树这样基本的事情时，这表明需要有意识地让他们重新接触自然世界。这种教育不仅仅是关于事实，更是关于培养一种惊奇感和联系感，从而塑造他们未来对造物的理解和关怀。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.en: Babies born to anaemic mothers have smaller brains, study finds
title.zh: 研究发现贫血母亲所生婴儿大脑较小

summary.en: A study has found that babies born to mothers with anemia have smaller brains, especially in key regions associated with movement, learning, and emotional regulation. These differences, detectable from one year of age, could potentially lead to cognitive issues when the children start school.
summary.zh: 一项研究发现，患有贫血症的母亲所生的婴儿大脑较小，尤其是在与运动、学习和情绪调节相关的关键区域。这些差异从一岁起即可检测到，并可能导致孩子入学时出现认知问题。

body.en: Key regions of the brain linked to movement, learning and emotions were affected and may lead to cognitive problems Babies born to mothers with anaemia have smaller brains, particularly in key regions linked to movement, learning and the regulation of emotion, according to a study. Researchers said the differences, first detected at the age of one, could lead to cognitive problems when children started school. Continue reading...
body.zh: 一项研究表明，与运动、学习和情绪相关的大脑关键区域受到影响，并可能导致认知问题患有贫血的母亲所生的婴儿的大脑较小，特别是与运动、学习和情绪调节相关的关键区域。研究人员表示，这些差异在一岁时首次发现，可能会导致孩子们开始上学时出现认知问题。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This study reveals a profound connection between maternal health and infant development, showing how anemia can affect crucial brain regions. It calls us to consider the unseen vulnerabilities of the most defenseless among us and to advocate for their well-being before birth.
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了母体健康与婴儿发育之间深刻的联系，表明贫血症会影响大脑的关键区域。它呼吁我们关注最弱小者身上看不见的脆弱之处，并在他们出生前就为他们的福祉发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: How AI is changing PhD programmes: join our free webinar
title.zh: 人工智能如何改变博士课程：加入我们的免费网络研讨会

summary.en: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02751-7 Learn how artificial intelligence can hone your research skills as well as the potential pitfalls of relying too heavily on it.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志，在线发表：2026年9月9日；doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02751-7 了解人工智能如何磨练您的研究技能，以及过度依赖它的潜在陷阱。

reflection.en: As artificial intelligence reshapes academic pursuits, this news prompts reflection on the enduring human drive for knowledge. Proverbs 18:15 speaks to this, reminding us that the pursuit of understanding is a valuable endeavor, even as we navigate new technological tools. May we use these advancements wisely, seeking deeper insight rather than mere...
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能重塑学术追求，这则新闻促使我们反思人类对知识的持久追求。箴言18:15谈到了这一点，提醒我们，即使在驾驭新的技术工具时，追求理解也是一项有价值的事业。愿我们明智地使用这些进步，寻求更深的洞察力，而不仅仅是效率。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Bacteria recruited to treat cancer
title.zh: 细菌被招募用于治疗癌症

summary.en: Anticancer drugs could be manufactured and delivered by modified microorganisms.
summary.zh: 经过改造的微生物可以制造和输送抗癌药物。

reflection.en: The intricate workings of life, even at the microbial level, offer profound insights. As scientists harness these tiny organisms for healing, we see a reflection of the Creator's wisdom embedded in the natural world. It is a testament to the potential for discovery when we observe and learn from Yahweh's creation.
reflection.zh: 生命错综复杂的运作，即使在微生物层面，也提供了深刻的见解。科学家们利用这些微小的生物来治愈疾病，这反映了造物主的智慧蕴含在自然界中。当我们观察和学习雅伟的创造时，它证明了发现的潜力。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: In the basement of miniaturized relics
title.zh: 地下室里微缩文物的踪迹

summary.en: This article from Nature explores the fascinating world of 'miniaturized relics' found in basement archives, hinting at the vastness of knowledge contained within even the smallest and most overlooked historical artifacts.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志的这篇文章探讨了在地下档案中发现的“微缩文物”的迷人世界，暗示着即使在最小、最被忽视的历史文物中也蕴含着浩瀚的知识。

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge often leads us to unexpected places, like the basement archives mentioned in this story. It reminds us that wisdom is not always found in the grand or obvious, but can be uncovered through diligent observation and study of the world around us, even in its smallest forms. As Job 12:7 says, 'But ask the animals, and they will teach...
reflection.zh: 求知的过程常常将我们引向意想不到的地方，正如故事中提到的地下档案室。这提醒我们，智慧并非总是显而易见或宏伟的，它可以通过勤奋的观察和对周围世界的学习来发现，即使是最微小的形式。正如约伯书12:7所说：“但你且问走兽，它们必指教你；天空飞鸟，也必告诉你。”

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: OpenAI claims to have solved maths problem that stumped humans for decades
title.zh: OpenAI 声称已解决困扰人类数十年的数学难题

summary.en: OpenAI, the company behind ChatGPT, announced it has solved the Navier-Stokes problem, a significant mathematical challenge that has perplexed humans for nearly a century. The company utilized 10,000 of its AI systems, which reportedly cracked the problem in 88 hours after millions of dollars in investment.
summary.zh: ChatGPT 的开发公司 OpenAI 宣布，他们已经解决了困扰人类近一个世纪的重大数学难题——纳维-斯托克斯方程。该公司动用了 10,000 个其人工智能系统，据称在投入数百万美元后，仅用 88 小时就攻克了该问题。

body.en: Company behind ChatGPT says 10,000 of its AI systems cracked the Navier-Stokes problem in 88 hours OpenAI claims to have solved a major mathematics problem that has stumped humans for nearly a century after spending millions of dollars on the artificial intelligence-led endeavour. The company behind ChatGPT said it had cracked the Navier-Stokes problem, one of seven Millennium Prize Problems published by the Clay Mathematics Institute to highlight some of the biggest unsolved puzzles in the field. Continue reading...
body.zh: ChatGPT 背后的公司表示，其 10,000 个人工智能系统在 88 小时内破解了纳维-斯托克斯问题。 OpenAI 声称在花费数百万美元进行人工智能主导的努力后，已经解决了一个困扰人类近一个世纪的重大数学问题。 ChatGPT 背后的公司表示，它已经破解了纳维-斯托克斯问题，这是克莱数学研究所发布的七个千年奖问题之一，旨在强调该领域一些最大的未解决难题。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as seen in OpenAI's claimed solution to the Navier-Stokes problem, mirrors the biblical observation that "many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase" (Daniel 12:4). This era of accelerating discovery calls us to pursue not just knowledge, but also the wisdom to use it for good.
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如 OpenAI 所声称的解决了纳维-斯托克斯方程一样，呼应了《圣经》中“必有多人来往奔走，知识也必增长”（但以理 12:4）的预言。这个加速发现的时代，呼唤我们不仅追求知识，更要追求运用知识行善的智慧。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。
